This rings especially true for the individuals who have earned the honor of serving in the elite task force that is the Navy SEALs, a group of highly trained combat warriors – a brotherhood – in which I earned a spot following my graduation from the United States Naval Academy at Annapolis.

Being a SEAL isn’t a one-man job; it takes teamwork, problem-solving, and coming to a consensus. **When you’re on missions in the harshest environments known to man, you must act as a unit and recognize you’re only as strong as the weakest among you.**

clean_body: The only way to pull America out of this leftist tailspin is by taking back the Senate in 2024 | | Peter, I’ve always known that I was meant to live a life of service, but I could never have imagined that perhaps the toughest mission of my life wouldn’t be as a Navy SEAL but rather as a combat veteran preparing to run for the United States Senate. Peter, I am under no illusions that you will back my campaign the first time you hear from me. But my life experiences have taught me that anything worth having requires working tirelessly, breaking down walls, and moving mountains to get it. I hope you will allow me to earn your support today by reading my entire message - I promise, it’s worth the read. In the Navy, finding yourself between a rock and a hard place is easy. This rings especially true for the individuals who have earned the honor of serving in the elite task force that is the Navy SEALs, a group of highly trained combat warriors – a brotherhood – in which I earned a spot following my graduation from the United States Naval Academy at Annapolis. Being a SEAL isn’t a one-man job; it takes teamwork, problem-solving, and coming to a consensus. When you’re on missions in the harshest environments known to man, you must act as a unit and recognize you’re only as strong as the weakest among you. I’ve deployed to Iraq, Afghanistan, South America, and the Pacific during my time as a SEAL, and I have been involved in dozens of engagements with enemy forces and survived to tell the tales. And believe me, there are some tales. I’ve seen the world’s dangers and stood up for freedom in the face of terrorism. I know the strength it takes to stand up and fight for what is right – which is why Our homeland is in danger. Not from overseas terrorists but Washington’s radical Democrats who want to fundamentally alter the fabric of this GREAT nation. This FAR-LEFT liberal agenda is assaulting our society, communities, and the American Dream. The Democrats’ grip on power is seriously undermining our freedom, prosperity, and security. The only way to pull America out of this leftist tailspin is by taking back the Senate in 2024, and our path to the Majority runs through this race in Montana. Over the days and weeks ahead, you’ll receive emails from me and my team as we build our campaign. **GET TO KNOW VIVEK:** Vivek is an American entrepreneur, political and cultural thought leader, and New York Times bestselling author of **_Woke, Inc.: Inside Corporate America's Social Justice Scam_** , along with his second book, **_Nation of Victims: Identity Politics, the Death of Merit, and the Path Back to Excellence_**.

He has been a prominent and outspoken critic against ESG, discriminatory practices under the guise of critical race theory, and of what he calls "government-tech censorship," where the government colludes with big tech to do through the backdoor what it couldn't do through the front door under the Constitution.

Vivek is a first-generation American. Growing up in the Cincinnati area, he often recounts the sage advice he received from his father that "If you're going to stand out, then you might as well be outstanding." This advice set the course for his life: an accomplished pianist, a nationally ranked tennis player, and the valedictorian of his Jesuit high school. He went on to graduate summa cum laude in Biology from Harvard in 2007 and received his J.D. degree from Yale Law School in 2013, worked at a hedge fund, then started a pharmaceutical company, Roivant Sciences, where his team developed five drugs that went on to become FDA-approved.

In 2022, he founded Strive Asset Management, an Ohio-based firm, that takes direct aim at asset managers like BlackRock, State Street, Vanguard and others for their fiduciary breach of duty to maximize the wealth of their clients for Wokeism. Strive's mission is to restore the voices of everyday citizens in the American economy by leading companies to focus on excellence over politics.

| | Everything I learned about hard work, I learned from my parents growing up in Tukwila.

My dad worked in construction, while my mom was the office manager at our elementary school. They worked hard their whole careers, and thanks to successful public policy programs like Social Security and Medicare, my mom was able to retire and live with dignity in my childhood home.

**But today, folks in Washington are finding it harder and harder to save for retirement. Helping solve this problem has been a major focus for me in the State Senate, and I believe it’s important for future Governor.**

This weekend, we’ll celebrate the 58th anniversary of Medicare, which for the last few generations has supported aging Americans as they leave the workforce. National programs like Medicare and Social Security were created with the understanding that hard-working Americans deserve support in retirement – but with the future of those national programs in constant jeopardy, it’s up to state governments to pick up the slack.

Here in Washington state, workers are just starting to see a new payroll tax deducted from their paychecks as our state implements a new long-term care insurance program.

While the goals of this program are admirable, the devil is in the details of the policy. This program has already received much-deserved criticism for its inability to use the long-term care benefits from this program in any other state but Washington. We know that half of Washington workers choose to retire in another state, meaning half of our residents could pay this tax their whole life and never receive a penny of benefits.

**As our state becomes more unaffordable because of housing and our rising cost of living, our state government shouldn’t add insult to injury with another mandatory tax.**

[If you agree that we can’t tax our way out of every problem, please support my campaign by pitching in $10 today!](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/67164766/418840115/-1267275108?amount=10&source=MM_EM_FR_90DO_230727_1_1&refcode2=d6bb7f90-e62c-ee11-b8f0-00224832eb73&contactdata=sJ6WY3HuiAd5iHZIbub9GhKAw0lVIes3w4XU+wPJzS0ieCSXRQWtlbL2dDT2RtgQ&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTAvMS84MzAxMCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJkNmJiN2Y5MC1lNjJjLWVlMTEtYjhmMC0wMDIyNDgzMmViNzMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=w0YsXxt5cvaFKxbFu1r2DjE-qtaJLG8nDomc3ztgzHc=)

We don’t have to look far for another solution to provide long-term care savings for families in Washington. Just to the south of us, Oregon has started the groundbreaking “Oregon Saves” program to help working people get ready for retirement, even if their employer does not provide retirement benefits. The savings from this program can be used for long-term care, or any other unexpected expenses in retirement. Unlike the Long-Term Care Payroll tax, retirement savings are fully portable, so you don't have to worry about losing benefits if you choose to retire in a different state.

Our state could be leading the nation in retirement systems by incentivizing people to save more. Instead, we’ve implemented a regressive tax that provides limited benefits.

[We need real change in order to secure the future of our state. Join us by contributing $10 before midnight on July 31st.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/67164769/418840119/-1267275108?amount=10&source=MM_EM_FR_90DO_230727_1_1&refcode2=d6bb7f90-e62c-ee11-b8f0-00224832eb73&contactdata=sJ6WY3HuiAd5iHZIbub9GhKAw0lVIes3w4XU+wPJzS0ieCSXRQWtlbL2dDT2RtgQ&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTAvMS84MzAxMCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJkNmJiN2Y5MC1lNjJjLWVlMTEtYjhmMC0wMDIyNDgzMmViNzMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=w0YsXxt5cvaFKxbFu1r2DjE-qtaJLG8nDomc3ztgzHc=)

National programs like Medicare and Social Security were created with the understanding that hard-working Americans deserve support in retirement – but with the future of those national programs in constant jeopardy, it’s up to state governments to pick up the slack. = If you've stored your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will process immediately. | | = | = | = | = | = | = Here in Washington state, workers are just starting to see a new payroll tax deducted from their paychecks as our state implements a new long-term care insurance program. While the goals of this program are admirable, the devil is in the details of the policy. This program has already received much-deserved criticism for its inability to use the long-term care benefits from this program in any other state but Washington. We know that half of Washington workers choose to retire in another state, meaning half of our residents could pay this tax their whole life and never receive a penny of benefits. As our state becomes more unaffordable because of housing and our rising cost of living, our state government shouldn’t add insult to injury with another mandatory tax. = We don’t have to look far for another solution to provide long-term care savings for families in Washington. Just to the south of us, Oregon has started the groundbreaking “Oregon Saves” program to help working people get ready for retirement, even if their employer does not provide retirement benefits. The savings from this program can be used for long-term care, or any other unexpected expenses in retirement. Unlike the Long-Term Care Payroll tax, retirement savings are fully portable, so you don't have to worry about losing benefits if you choose to retire in a different state. Our state could be leading the nation in retirement systems by incentivizing people to save more. Instead, we’ve implemented a regressive tax that provides limited benefits. = Thanks so much, Mark | Mark Mullet is running for Governor to make Washington safe, affordable and prosperous. | | ---|---|--- | = ** Paid for by Elect Mark Mullet Mullet for Governor (D) PO Box 2072 Issaquah, WA 98027 United States

| Just moments ago, special counsel Jack Smith filed additional charges against Donald Trump, including alleged attempts to have surveillance footage at Mar-a-Lago deleted.
# [](https://act.adamschiff.com/go/61?t=1&akid=3152%2E5257348%2EqHdGxC)
Derek,
I have some pretty big breaking news:
**Just moments ago, special counsel Jack Smith filed additional charges against Donald Trump, including alleged attempts to have surveillance footage at Mar-a-Lago deleted.**
The evidence against Trump just got stronger. A lot stronger. The twice-indicted, twice-impeached ex-president now has NEW charges filed against him: the alteration, destruction, and concealment of records.
And that’s not all. There is reporting that additional charges against him stemming from his effort to overturn the last election may be imminent. We’re coming toward an inflection point, and a fraught moment in the history of our democracy. _But considering the interests of justice and the rule of law, it’s about damn time._
Today’s charges — and those that may follow — are an affirmation of the principle that the law applies equally to everyone, or at least it should, and that includes people who were formerly the president of the United States. Anything less is less than democracy.
Derek, I have no doubt that Donald Trump is going to react to this new superseding indictment or the next one to come, just like he’s reacted to past indictments: a lot of deflecting, pushing blame on others, and going on the offense — with the attacks against those who investigated these crimes (including me) not far off. And more ominously, with thinly-veiled or not-so-thinly-veiled calls to violence. Trump is willing to tear down the whole democratic house to save his skin.
And just like clockwork, Republican leaders will fall in line to protect Trump. Because the only thing that seems to matter to them is obtaining and keeping power.
They will attempt to retaliate against _anyone_ who works to uphold the rule of law and defend our Constitution against Trump’s abuses of office — which makes me a prime target for their attacks.
But I won’t back down. Not now, not ever.

I’m not a typical Congressman, Peter.

I’m not a millionaire who was born into powerful connections.

**I’m a kid from the Bronx who was raised by a single mother on the minimum wage, so I’ve _lived_ the experiences that many other politicians just talk about.**

I’ve experienced food and housing insecurity.
I’ve faced racism and homophobia firsthand.
People I love have been ensnared by the criminal justice system.

Peter, people like me don’t usually end up in the halls of power.

**But despite all of the odds,_I won_ and became the first openly gay Afro-Latino to be elected to Congress.**

And every time I walk into my office, I feel the weight of history on my shoulders -- because I know how much work we have to do.

We were given a mandate by the American people in 2020, and it’s _our duty_ to make the most of it.

We have _a duty_ to end child poverty.
We have _a duty_ to create safe housing.
We have _a duty_ to protect our nation’s most vulnerable.

So we need to prepare now to protect it.

I’m in Congress to fight for the people of this country. **So I really need help from grassroots donors like you.**

[My team wants to raise $10,000 this month, and at our current pace, I don’t know if we’ll make it. Donald Trump's lawyers met with Department of Justice attorneys as his third federal indictment looms, and Trump later described the session as a "." Senators Push for New Board to Police Big Tech The surprising team of Sens. Elizabeth Warren and Lindsey Graham have introduced a bill to create to regulate the major online platforms. The new agency, to be called the Digital Consumer Protection Commission, would police Big Tech firms in cases of anti-competitive actions and consumer privacy violations. Both parties in Congress have struggled to find a way to control online abuses. This bill "makes clear that reining in Big Tech platforms is a top priority ," Warren said. Angels Bet Their Season on Superstar Ohtani The Los Angeles Angels say they , their superstar pitcher/hitter who some consider the greatest baseball player of all time, even though Ohtani will be a free agent when the season ends. name: Friends of the Earth
subject: Your Signature is Needed: Polar bears are starving
body:
| | | | | [](https://us.engagingnetworks.app/page/email/click/10012/1901090?email=RepJ2ZGQKX6xm5Aey7FwClESkN1MQhKC&campid=UI6tX83ZqbKZkArzVWMSmA==)
---|---|---

| | **URGENT ACTION NEEDED: Stop cruise corporations from DUMPING waste in fragile Arctic habitats!** Picture this: polar bear cubs stumbling across the ice, mother close behind. They’re searching for food – but with no luck. Their hunting grounds are _**MELTING**_ , and the ocean’s tasty fish have been _**SCARED AWAY**_ by cruise ships’ pollution and noise. If things don’t change soon, **this mama bear and her cubs could starve!** Only _**900 Southern Beaufort polar bears remain**_ – and with the Arctic warming TWICE AS FAST as the rest of the world, these threatened creatures could be on the path to _**extinction!**_ Cruise ships won’t hold themselves accountable, but you can help push the EPA to STOP cruise pollution and protect the Arctic, its people, and wildlife! [**SAVE THE ARCTIC: send your message to the EPA and fight corporate cruise companies!**](https://us.engagingnetworks.app/page/email/click/10012/1901091?email=RepJ2ZGQKX6xm5Aey7FwClESkN1MQhKC&campid=UI6tX83ZqbKZkArzVWMSmA==) | [SIGN THE PETITION](https://us.engagingnetworks.app/page/email/click/10012/1901092?email=RepJ2ZGQKX6xm5Aey7FwClESkN1MQhKC&campid=UI6tX83ZqbKZkArzVWMSmA==)
---
Arctic Indigenous communities rely on the ocean’s resources to support themselves. But cruise ships **pollute the ocean** and **drive away animals** that are essential to these communities’ way of life.
One of the worst offenders – Carnival Corporation – carried _**11,000 tons of hazardous heavy fuel oil**_ in a single year through Arctic waters — nearly three times as much as its largest competitor.
Cruise ships in the Arctic are a disaster waiting to happen. The EPA could act RIGHT NOW to protect this critical habitat – but it’s failed to act. [**Please, Friend, will you help us reach our goal of 2,839 more signatures before MIDNIGHT? Sign and PROTECT the Arctic before it’s too late!**](https://us.engagingnetworks.app/page/email/click/10012/1901093?email=RepJ2ZGQKX6xm5Aey7FwClESkN1MQhKC&campid=UI6tX83ZqbKZkArzVWMSmA==)
[SIGN THE PETITION](https://us.engagingnetworks.app/page/email/click/10012/1901092?email=RepJ2ZGQKX6xm5Aey7FwClESkN1MQhKC&campid=UI6tX83ZqbKZkArzVWMSmA==)
---
**Standing with you,
Marcie Keever
Oceans and vessels program director,
Friends of the Earth**

| |

| | Peter,

Three years ago, I was defamed by the media, censored by social media companies, and viciously attacked, all for questioning the “science” and advocating for the right of physicians to prescribe what they know will save lives.

As I am in Washington DC, [standing with thousands of truth-telling doctors](https://drscottjensen.us8.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b954d633401c69368c934973f&id=24e00f0b8a&e=9828080a05) and supporters, one thing is clear to me: The politicization of medicine must stop, and the censorship of doctors must never happen again. [Please watch this video](https://drscottjensen.us8.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b954d633401c69368c934973f&id=d90fccba8d&e=9828080a05) I recorded with America's Frontline Doctors by clicking the thumbnail below:
---
| [ ](https://drscottjensen.us8.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b954d633401c69368c934973f&id=1ba355d6f4&e=9828080a05 "They defamed me")
---
| [I proudly stood](https://drscottjensen.us8.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b954d633401c69368c934973f&id=bb071da099&e=9828080a05) yesterday with other physicians at the Supreme Court of the United States with over 100,000 petition signatures to call for an investigation into Fauci's mis-dealings & corruption. Dissenting scientists will not be silenced.

"Never before have we seen such a blatantly corrupt government official not be prosecuted." The moment of truth and reconciliation is nearly upon us, but first: there must be a moment of holding officials accountable. [Please watch and share](https://drscottjensen.us8.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b954d633401c69368c934973f&id=2520fcef4c&e=9828080a05).

Standing for Freedom,

Dr. Scott Jensen
Minnesota Family Doctor

| **Weekly Newsletter**
---
| | Derek,

If you live in Northwood or Nottingham, remember to vote on Tuesday, August 1st in the Republican Primary!

I want to give a shout-out to [**Jessica Sternberg**](https://5wbjs096.r.us-east-1.awstrack.me/L0/https:%2F%2Ftwitter.com%2FJSternberg077/1/010001899c606c81-ce720c97-9f18-4e4a-b362-f2198370b677-000000/fEQzr2v8U8dddbX9VIqRK96RWSQ=332) who has been extremely active in knocking on doors and talking to voters in her district!

We need to keep Rockingham 01 in Republican hands, and that pivotal general election will be held on Tuesday, September 19th.

**Don't Mass Up New Hampshire**

Joyce Craig and Cinde Warmington would do EVERYTHING in their power to turn New Hampshire into Northern Massachusetts.

We need to fight back and organize NOW in order to stop either of those Democrats from becoming Governor in 2024.

[Donate $20.24 to Granite Solutions](https://5wbjs096.r.us-east-1.awstrack.me/L0/https:%2F%2Fsecure.winred.com%2Fgranitesolutions%2Fdont-mass-up-nh-bumper-stickers/1/010001899c606c81-ce720c97-9f18-4e4a-b362-f2198370b677-000000/y6kTIMnoaQmH3kcseR42FwhG17E=332) today and we'll send you 2 "_**Don't Mass Up New Hampshire**_ " Bumper Stickers - put one on your car and give one to a friend or loved one to help spread the message!

It's important we spread the word and let people know what's at stake in 2024. We are one election away from becoming Massachusetts-lite instead of the envy of the nation that we are.

**Share Your Inflation Story**

I want to hear from you!

Every Granite Stater has been impacted by the Democrats' Rampant Inflation. Please share your story with Granite Solutions and we'll share it with the Granite State!**
**
Go to [https://www.granitesolutions.org/inflation-story](https://5wbjs096.r.us-east-1.awstrack.me/L0/https:%2F%2Fwww.granitesolutions.org%2Finflation-story/1/010001899c606c81-ce720c97-9f18-4e4a-b362-f2198370b677-000000/utAoBYWNmdrmsHmol6lUF6iW_RY=332) to share your inflation story today!****
****
**Get Involved****
**
Remember, there are numerous ways to get involved with Granite Solutions. Whether it's knocking on doors, making phone calls, or becoming a Town/Ward Captain, we need you on our team. To find out more, visit our website at[www.GraniteSolutions.org/volunteer](https://5wbjs096.r.us-east-1.awstrack.me/L0/https:%2F%2Fwww.granitesolutions.org%2Fvolunteer/1/010001899c606c81-ce720c97-9f18-4e4a-b362-f2198370b677-000000/8JUhXWe7088SkrEf9X51zMaE6cM=332).

As always, I'm humbled by your support and commitment to our shared values. Together, we are making a difference for New Hampshire. Let's keep the momentum going!

Best,

Rep. Joe Sweeney
Chairman, Granite Solutions

**I hope you will allow me to earn your support today by reading my entire message - I promise, it’s worth the read.**

In the Navy, finding yourself between a rock and a hard place is easy. This rings especially true for the individuals who have earned the honor of serving in the elite task force that is the Navy SEALs, a group of highly trained combat warriors – a brotherhood – in which I earned a spot following my graduation from the United States Naval Academy at Annapolis.

Being a SEAL isn’t a one-man job; it takes teamwork, problem-solving, and coming to a consensus. **When you’re on missions in the harshest environments known to man, you must act as a unit and recognize you’re only as strong as the weakest among you.**

I’ve deployed to Iraq, Afghanistan, South America, and the Pacific during my time as a SEAL, and I have been involved in dozens of engagements with enemy forces and survived to tell the tales. _And believe me, there are some tales._

**I’ve seen the world’s dangers and stood up for freedom in the face of terrorism.** I know the strength it takes to stand up and fight for what is right – which is why [**I am determined to take on the anti-American, radical Left in Washington as Montana’s next U.S. Senator.**](http://links.makingamericathegreatest.com/u/click?_t=79fa4a3daf024a0a886c5b498ff32e32&_m=804ba31a77e443e2b4a502dc9f4f3d50&_e=n4zoExjv83BVP70PLMTaZzgmpMsvxocMPhV0ep_JVVh0tGYgTcDFD8lN2pcB6ct7lvYm5VmK7X9UVp3moDPnFIRdASDCKQ7lxFWyI_smYMIRSF5PV4k2n1RQhN7ommxoRMbbezen0D6TpAoXzJt0CoNDZDxeEHaa2JDQUQkgiMiJOyk6TcTov-c4V_MztH-T4RKbK8AEgljsAvZrMQD9sjF1D7qyBc9ZCDmqD4D9JHZcZDBewXtHkleebOTZnJ0aw6BMLlg2Mog2yk3XsC27MJmTrtAzjKBaMPiT9dqY0nR4eQlH9r1w_IvV-4a3vYo07TH97YNH0ARb5y9fYM-WzR93CO9KDImK2C5zr128U4JTlVi0w2qDPp1R1gLrRHqKPIKpn84j2hx3XSfzWk06Jw%3D%3D)

name: Vivek Ramaswamy
subject: Wokeness killing the American Dream
disclaimer_text:
Paid for
by Vivek 2024
body:
http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/p/vsIgyoxDGN

Vivek 2024

I'm a first-generation American, born and raised in Ohio.
I got ahead based on merit, not my skin color. I am running for
President...

http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/p/osIgyoxDGN

Fellow American,

Wokeness is a new secular
religion that says your identity is based on your race and
sexuality. This is destroying America in front of our eyes.

I'm on a mission to stop it. I
wrote two bestselling books and started a new company to take on
wokeness on Wall Street, but we must do more and address the real
problem: we are going through a national identity crisis.

I'm Vivek Ramaswamy, and I
launched my campaign for President of the United States to
deliver an answer to the most important question of our time:
what it means to be an American. Today I am asking YOU to be a
part of our movement.

JOIN VIVEK →

I remember when I was in 2nd
grade and heard Martin Luther King's "I Have Dream" speech for
the first time: America judges its children not on the color of
their skin, but on the content of their character.

I grew up in Ohio in the 90s to
two immigrants who came to this country with almost no money. I
was a skinny kid with nerdy glasses and a funny last name.
Achievement was my ticket to get ahead. After graduating from
Harvard and Yale, I went on to start a family and founded
multibillion-dollar companies.

You probably know me as the
author of Woke, Inc. - or by what left-leaning outlets have
called me, like "the intellectual godfather of the anti-woke
movement" (Politico), "CEO of Anti-Woke, Inc.," (The New Yorker),
or the "right's leading anti-ESG crusader" (Axios, Bloomberg, and
others). I take their criticisms as a badge of honor because we
are standing up for what is right - and true.

I'm 37 years old. People my age
and younger can't even answer what it means to be an American
today.

My peers have abandoned faith,
patriotism, and hard work and instead embrace new secular
religions like covidism, climatism, and radical gender ideology.

I'm running for President of the
United States of America to revive the ideals that made America
great - and made America itself. If this is important to you too,
then I need you to be a part of this movement. Will you help me
launch my campaign by throwing in a contribution of $10, $25, $40
or more today?

JOIN VIVEK →

It's not enough to just be
AGAINST something like wokeness... we need to be FOR something.

We are on a mission to create a
new American Dream for the next generation.

We must embrace merit and
excellence in every sphere of our lives:

Merit in who gets into America.
More immigrants like my parents, instead of illegal immigrants
who break the law to enter the country.

Merit in who gets ahead in
America. You win in America not on the color of your skin, but on
the content of your character and contributions.

Merit in who governs America. I
have a humble dream that the people who we elect to run the
government should be the ones who actually run the government,
not federal bureaucrats who multiply themselves like a national
cancer.

Merit in the marketplace of
ideas. The best ideas win when no ideas are censored.

I think you believe in these
ideals. I think you believe your neighbors and colleagues believe
in these ideals too, but you can't be sure because you're not
allowed to talk about it anymore. We still agree on the basic
ideals - at least most of us do.

I am running for President to
save the ideals that made America great. Please stand with me in
the fight to revive American exceptionalism by contributing $10,
$25, $40 or another amount to help me launch my campaign.

For The American Dream,

Vivek Ramaswamy

JOIN VIVEK →

Paid for
by Vivek 2024

Contributions to Vivek 2024 are
not deductible as charitable contributions for Federal income tax
purposes.

Funds received in response to
this solicitation are subject to federal contribution limits.
Contributions from corporations, labor unions, foreign nationals
without green cards, and federal government contractors are
prohibited. Federal law requires us to use our best efforts to
collect and report the name, mailing address, occupation, and

I volunteered to fly Apache helicopters in Iraq because I wanted to defend our freedom. Now, I’m serving AGAIN to save our country from the radical socialists.

I know you’re just like me. You want to see the best for our nation. That’s why it’s critical that we prevent the Democrats from buying our election.

**Radical Leftists in the Beltway are planning to spend MILLIONS to silence me. They don’t want another black conservative voice speaking out against their hypocrisy.** **[_If I’m going to defeat their Marxist agenda, I’m going to need a lot of help. That’s why I’m humbly asking for your support._](http://links.right-gop.com/u/click?_t=2ba4f933732b46f5b6eae32741d1832c&_m=16aa67d784c743e99100b018675d61c4&_e=nZ4Mqf8C1yYbE24vc4zk3wccWN7xgnlaXbbFNF0_LgIuO975AO_oc6Vow3zcK_dli7ke_0hU2mZ9mwrla6yC-z7AWI8etTL6IcMtroRkFPv2Gs57oI5S_IsRqqO7aJ9tsuTgxuxg1ckluTS-gw5aqjZXTFzhq_6vMN5gvc6LGnHycxUqgBM9Uv1TofEfQgZ_Q6K-26fxGB2u7z9ijYiQxLpEmoTg8-RkqzBUoSagk9PPNVnZO8f8scIgjqOnvLTcz8JAxjSv65cy8epDUOKgO53j2klawo7KYdih2PDQ8Hpkd2n9IUFWHSHQUZGVIzKR0z6LmvsM5ocgavpAjjkBp-dAXd_Gp7Fuf8PfgIEAOkTDu1xu5CQdZx6Rll8qJJBkFATt-hG3-JvS3_X60VeRNNTzGWJ2s9AlVLVju-yeUxYNVQBJMFtIyx2eTjJww9OVOrnp1seUiWrr1Mu5bFP4QgXx7yw-LZo3EtnwiErO-4INaBl2wgthtFOT4TnC45z4)**

[**PITCH IN NOW TO HELP A FORMER APACHE PILOT**](http://links.right-gop.com/u/click?_t=2ba4f933732b46f5b6eae32741d1832c&_m=16aa67d784c743e99100b018675d61c4&_e=nZ4Mqf8C1yYbE24vc4zk3wccWN7xgnlaXbbFNF0_LgIuO975AO_oc6Vow3zcK_dli7ke_0hU2mZ9mwrla6yC-z7AWI8etTL6IcMtroRkFPv2Gs57oI5S_IsRqqO7aJ9tsuTgxuxg1ckluTS-gw5aqjZXTFzhq_6vMN5gvc6LGnHycxUqgBM9Uv1TofEfQgZ_Q6K-26fxGB2u7z9ijYiQxLpEmoTg8-RkqzBUoSagk9PPNVnZO8f8scIgjqOnvLTcz8JAxjSv65cy8epDUOKgO53j2klawo7KYdih2PDQ8Hpkd2n9IUFWHSHQUZGVIzKR0z6LmvsM5ocgavpAjjkBp-dAXd_Gp7Fuf8PfgIEAOkQ5qkfFnyxBjN2AQvNSNJ45rFbsPe09_iBjn-XPf9JkWDQVJLA25S5BbKotyrf7QE6NidqRPAFxUdIPEgLu0fZegINgOUyLlq3Gz_NbgSBrksa7nU7kuS_u0flvOdAOSuRTh2CHSy1HzC-Kv_RY5b8m)

My last election was decided by **1,600 votes**. The Democrat Establishment almost took me down, but with the support of patriots like you, **_I was victorious_**. We might not be so lucky next time. There is nothing compassionate about chemically castrating a teenage boy. And there's nothing compassionate about doing a double mastectomy on a teenage girl. But that is exactly what is happening at prominent medical institutions across the country, because adults who know better refuse to stand up against this madness.
That's why I am moving a bill through Congress to fight back. My bill is very simple -- all it says is that taxpayer dollars that support the Children's Hospital Graduate Medical Education Program cannot be used to fund facilities that engage in unproven, dangerous medical practices on our kids. When 70% of taxpayers oppose using puberty blockers on children - let alone hormone therapy or sex change surgery - taxpayers should not have to fund these programs.
This bill has advanced through my Energy and Commerce Committee and will likely be on the House floor some time this fall. The left has fought this bill tooth and nail - using emotional arguments and labeling my efforts "cruel," attacks which are breathlessly repeated by the left's allies in the mainstream media. These attacks will only increase as this bill gets closer to a vote in the full House of Representatives.
That's why I need your help. Sign the below petition to stand with me against this radical pseudoscience that is threatening an entire generation of our kids. This is the fight of our time, and I need you standing beside me.

| Another issue the left claims the moral high ground on is the border crisis. The left claims that it is "compassionate" to allow migrants to flood into our country illegally without consequence. But, once again, there is nothing compassionate about the left's stance on this issue. In fact, their open border policies lead to unspeakable atrocities.
What the left fails to acknowledge is the Mexican drug cartels are taking advantage of Joe Biden's lax enforcement of our country's immigration laws. The cartels advertise Biden's open border policies to migrants and then cash in on migrants making the dangerous journey to our southern border. One big money maker for the cartels is migrant children.
Under the Biden Administration, there has been a surge of unaccompanied migrant children crossing into our country. Unlike adult migrants, unaccompanied children must be placed into the care of the Department of Health and Human Services, which is responsible for their care in the Office of Refugee Resettlement. This week during an Energy and Commerce Committee hearing, I pressed the Secretary of Health and Human Services Secretary about how his department is handling the surge.
Due to the sheer number of unaccompanied children coming across our border, the Office of Refugee Resettlement (ORR) simply cannot take care of these kids in a responsible manner. Migrant children are quickly cleared through ORR facilities and into the care of sponsors who are not properly vetted. As a result, migrant children often end up in a pipeline to grueling labor that no child should be doing. And there are no laws on the books that require sponsors to answer wellness calls from ORR officials to make sure children are in safe environments. That needs to change.
Like everything else, the left's "compassion" have truly cruel consequences for the most vulnerable people. The illegal immigration crisis is no different, and migrant children are being abused and put in danger by the left's policies that allow this crisis to persist.

| | FROM THE DESK OF ALAN DERSHOWITZ
---
| | Dear Sun Reader,
---
| | In over sixty years in the legal profession, I’ve experienced first hand the impact of both good journalism and bad journalism — mostly the latter — and just how important and rare it is to get things right.

In today’s media landscape there are far too many publications that get things wrong. Many are more concerned with the political implications of a story than the basic facts.

The New York Sun is different. It’s a paper that places principle over politics and people over party.

Its in-depth coverage of the legal challenges faced by President Trump serve as a case in point.

When I defended President Trump during his first impeachment, I faced an avalanche of criticism, but few papers made sufficient effort to fully appreciate the significance of the legal arguments.

The Sun’s deeply knowledgeable leadership, including its editor Seth Lipsky and associate editor A.R. Hoffman are themselves students of the Constitution. It shows in their coverage, which I find to be first rate.

It will be no secret to you that I don’t agree with everything that can be found in the Sun’s pages, but I can say with confidence that its re-emergence is among the most important recent developments in American journalism.

I’ve been impressed by the Sun’s growth so far, but I know it faces an uphill battle, one that I have pledged to join.

The Sun’s success will be a gift to the American people and to the cause of truth. But to succeed, we need you to join us. I highly encourage you to join the Sun today.

Every person matters in this effort.

Don’t wait. The battle to restore American journalism starts now.

[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/67180505/418892649/-456841951?refcode=BEB_EM_FR_230728DAM_B_logo&amount=25&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTAvMS8xMDQzNDMiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiN2I0ODgxYjEtNTEyZC1lZTExLWI4ZjAtMDAyMjQ4MzJlYjczIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=_s7zhWUQ-DemAS3SLCIg_BTgQRFSNF4W1UsNFWu3Thg=) Peter,

This month is Disability Awareness Month. On Wednesday, we celebrated the anniversary of the Americans with Disabilities Act being signed into law – groundbreaking legislation that expanded rights and resources for folks with disabilities nationwide. Yet 33 years later, even after the major strides made by the ADA, there is still so much work to be done.

Some of you may know that I currently work as a litigation attorney for a leading Mississippi disability rights advocacy group, a role that allows me to tenaciously fight for access and opportunity on behalf of Mississippians with disabilities. My time as an advocate has shown me how we continue to fail folks with disabilities, even more than three decades after the passage of monumental legislation like the ADA.

Right now, I’m suing Mississippi’s current Attorney General for her efforts to make it even _harder_ for sick, elderly, and disabled folks to cast their votes in our elections. **Of the many issues our AG could choose to prioritize, she’s using taxpayer dollars to attack our state’s most vulnerable folks and actively weakening our democracy.**

I became a disability rights advocate because my career has revolved around serving others and giving a voice to those who most need it. That’s also why I’m running for Mississippi Attorney General – for far too long, our AG has harmed Mississippians, and I’m stepping up to work for people, not political agendas.

Peter, I was born and raised right here in Mississippi, and I know that we deserve better than what our current AG has given us. With your support, I’m ready to fight for every one of us against special interests and attacks on our rights. Getting to the AG’s office to take on this fight means I need your help right now.

| A native Floridian with blue-collar roots, Ron was raised in Dunedin by his mother, a nurse, and father, who installed cable boxes. He attended Dunedin High School and worked his way through Yale University, where he was the captain of the varsity baseball team. He also graduated with honors from Harvard Law School, where he earned a commission in the U.S. Navy as a JAG officer.

During his active-duty service, Ron deployed to Iraq in support of the SEAL mission in Fallujah, Ramadi and the rest of Al Anbar province. His military decorations include the Bronze Star Medal for Meritorious Service and the Iraq Campaign Medal.
---
Ron also served as a prosecutor in Florida, where he put child predators behind bars. He was elected to Congress in 2012 on a platform of government accountability, advocating for term limits and a balanced budget amendment.

In Congress, DeSantis spearheaded the fight to expose the weaponization of the IRS against conservatives. He also fought to hold accountable the rogue federal agencies involved in manufacturing the "Russia collusion" conspiracy theory. As a veteran, DeSantis was a champion for those who have served our country, pushing for reforms to the VA to better serve veterans and expand support for mental health.

In 2018, Ron DeSantis was elected the 46th Governor of Florida. As governor, he has fought for what's right and taken the arrows for the people he represents. During the darkest days of 2020, when the corrupt establishment, bureaucracy, and corporate media united to force lockdowns and mandates on Americans, DeSantis stood up for freedom - even when it wasn't popular.

Grounded in his unshakeable belief in America's founding principles, Governor DeSantis has enacted a bold agenda to transform Florida into a blueprint for the Nation's revival. Governor DeSantis has delivered win after win on conservative priorities:
* Saving livelihoods from job-killing lockdowns and vaccine mandates,

* Protecting citizens from the harmful impacts of Biden's border crisis by enacting E-Verify and other bold policies against illegal immigration, such as banning sanctuary cities,

* Defending parental rights and eliminating CRT,

* Defunding DEI bureaucracy in higher ed and holding tenured professors accountable,

* Waging war on woke power-grabs like ESG and central bank digital currency,

* Enacting the strongest medical freedom laws in the nation,

* Turning Florida into a model for election integrity,

* Protecting the unborn,

* Standing up for the 2nd Amendment by making Florida a constitutional carry state,

* Expanding education freedom,

* Prohibiting land purchases by the CCP and related individuals and entities,

* Lowering prescription drug costs,

* Holding woke corporations and school unions accountable,

* Creating a universal school choice program,

* Delivering record-breaking tax relief,

* Helping families achieve the American dream of homeownership,

* Supporting law enforcement and our veterans,

* Enacting tougher penalties for drug dealers and sex offenders,

* Appointing seven conservative justices to the Florida Supreme Court,

* ...and so much more.

Hey guys, I’m Angela’s daughter, Alex! I’m so excited to talk to you today
about why my mom is going to make an amazing Senator.

If I could describe my mom in a few words, they would be “energetic,”
“hardworking,” “caring,” and “courageous.” She wakes up every morning at 5
AM, works out (to Beyoncé of course), makes me breakfast, and when I was
in school, she’d drop me off every morning, no matter how busy her day
was.

She’s a great listener and loves to talk to everyone. That’s why we always
end up spending an extra 30 minutes at the grocery store just chatting
with people!

My mom can handle anything AND do it with understanding and ease. Whether
it’s leading Prince George’s County through a pandemic, helping me with
college applications, or running for office, she never backs down from a
challenge.

I’m so proud of my mom and I love to support her whenever I can, from
helping her practice her speeches to being her cheerleader at events to
making phone calls. But everything her campaign does depends on grassroots
donations, and we can’t win without your support.

| Meet **Mark Walker**

Congressman Mark Walker started his career in finance and, after earning his theology degree, Walker served 16 years as a pastor. In 2014, Walker stepped away from ministry and made a successful run for the U.S. Congress defeating a host of elected politicians. In 2015, Congressman Walker became the first member in an inaugural term to be elected Chair of the Republican Study Committee (RSC) - the largest caucus in Congress with 160 members and a position previously held by Vice President Pence and Congressman Jim Jordan.

In 2018, Walker was elected as Vice Chair of the entire conference, becoming the highest rated conservative to serve in the top four leadership positions in Congress. Walker is also the last member of Congress to secure a floor vote on a balanced budget amendment and led the House on HBCU initiatives winning the United Negro College Fund President’s list award. Congressman Walker served on multiple committees and in 2019, Walker was appointed to ranking member on the Committee on Homeland Security’s Intelligence and Counter-Terrorism’s subcommittee. Walker was co-chair of the bicameral prayer caucus for five years and also won the GOP MVP award as the starting pitcher on the Republican baseball team for the annual charity game.

Mike Huckabee, Hall of Fame Coach Tony Dungy and more than 200 pastors across North Carolina. **GET TO KNOW VIVEK:** Vivek is an American entrepreneur, political and cultural thought leader, and New York Times bestselling author of **_Woke, Inc.: Inside Corporate America's Social Justice Scam_** , along with his second book, **_Nation of Victims: Identity Politics, the Death of Merit, and the Path Back to Excellence_**.

He has been a prominent and outspoken critic against ESG, discriminatory practices under the guise of critical race theory, and of what he calls "government-tech censorship," where the government colludes with big tech to do through the backdoor what it couldn't do through the front door under the Constitution.

Vivek is a first-generation American. Growing up in the Cincinnati area, he often recounts the sage advice he received from his father that "If you're going to stand out, then you might as well be outstanding." This advice set the course for his life: an accomplished pianist, a nationally ranked tennis player, and the valedictorian of his Jesuit high school. He went on to graduate summa cum laude in Biology from Harvard in 2007 and received his J.D. degree from Yale Law School in 2013, worked at a hedge fund, then started a pharmaceutical company, Roivant Sciences, where his team developed five drugs that went on to become FDA-approved.

Don't melt!

I'm not letting this heat stifle our momentum and travels, and I hope it doesn't keep you from enjoying your summer! This week, I had a great time traveling to the Hamilton, Warrick, and Tippecanoe County fairs. Engaging with Hoosiers, hearing your thoughts, dreams, concerns, and aspirations drives my commitment to serve as your governor. Let's make history!

In this week's scoop, see my recent interview with WVPE 88.1, check out my pictures from the fairs, and read my statement on Indiana Department of Health's use of the term "chestfeeding." Also, I am blessed to receive 5 more endorsements this week!

Let's connect! I'd love to hear from you and any comments, questions, or concerns you have about Indiana and my run for Governor.

Here’s the thingR: I don’t have kids, and my husband and I have made a conscious decision not to have kids.

You’re probably asking yourself why I co-founded an organization that is entirely focused on kids and improving their future.

Let me explain: While I don’t plan to have kids, I still care about the direction this country is heading. Kids will inherit a world where the climate is in crisis, democracy is crumbling, and gun violence ends countless lives.

**And I believe they deserve better than that. It’s up to the current generation to make it better for them— _it’s our responsibility to take action._**

These kids will eventually be our doctors, lawyers, teachers, police officers and lawmakers, and we owe it to them to leave this place better than we found it. It doesn’t take a parent to understand the urgency.

The adage goes “It takes a village to raise a child”. It takes our collective effort to make sure that every child’s future is protected.

| | | Dear Friend, Your participation in Hillsdale College's **National Survey on the United States Supreme Court** is requested.

Your response will only take a few minutes, but the subject is crucial to the future of liberty and the separation of powers in America.

The American Founders thought that the proper role of the Supreme Court is to apply the Constitution.

But progressives see the Court differently. They want activist judges to legislate from the bench.
## Do you agree that the role of the Supreme Court is to apply the Constitution as it is written and NOT to make laws or advance a particular policy agenda?

| | Peter – This is our first end-of-month fundraising deadline of the quarter, and if we want to have a strong showing, we need to stay on top of these goals well before the FEC's big quarterly filing deadlines. **I can hear you saying to yourself, "Mark, what does that even mean!?"**
* We have to tell the FEC exactly how much money we raised every three months.
* They are going to publish that number.

body:
Derek, I’m a lifelong Pennsylvanian.

From growing up in Scranton, to coaching eighth-grade basketball in Philadelphia, to my wife, Terese, and I raising our four daughters in the same town where I grew up — Pennsylvania is my home.

That’s why I’m a tireless advocate for Pennsylvania’s hardworking families in the U.S. Senate. | A native Floridian with blue-collar roots, Ron was raised in Dunedin by his mother, a nurse, and father, who installed cable boxes. He attended Dunedin High School and worked his way through Yale University, where he was the captain of the varsity baseball team. He also graduated with honors from Harvard Law School, where he earned a commission in the U.S. Navy as a JAG officer.

During his active-duty service, Ron deployed to Iraq in support of the SEAL mission in Fallujah, Ramadi and the rest of Al Anbar province. His military decorations include the Bronze Star Medal for Meritorious Service and the Iraq Campaign Medal.

Ron also served as a prosecutor in Florida, where he put child predators behind bars. He was elected to Congress in 2012 on a platform of government accountability, advocating for term limits and a balanced budget amendment.

In Congress, DeSantis spearheaded the fight to expose the weaponization of the IRS against conservatives. He also fought to hold accountable the rogue federal agencies involved in manufacturing the "Russia collusion" conspiracy theory. As a veteran, DeSantis was a champion for those who have served our country, pushing for reforms to the VA to better serve veterans and expand support for mental health.

In 2018, Ron DeSantis was elected the 46th Governor of Florida. As governor, he has fought for what's right and taken the arrows for the people he represents. During the darkest days of 2020, when the corrupt establishment, bureaucracy, and corporate media united to force lockdowns and mandates on Americans, DeSantis stood up for freedom - even when it wasn't popular.

Grounded in his unshakeable belief in America's founding principles, Governor DeSantis has enacted a bold agenda to transform Florida into a blueprint for the Nation's revival. Governor DeSantis has delivered win after win on conservative priorities:
* Saving livelihoods from job-killing lockdowns and vaccine mandates,

* Protecting citizens from the harmful impacts of Biden's border crisis by enacting E-Verify and other bold policies against illegal immigration, such as banning sanctuary cities,

* Defending parental rights and eliminating CRT,

* Defunding DEI bureaucracy in higher ed and holding tenured professors accountable,

* Waging war on woke power-grabs like ESG and central bank digital currency,

* Enacting the strongest medical freedom laws in the nation,

* Turning Florida into a model for election integrity,

* Protecting the unborn,

* Standing up for the 2nd Amendment by making Florida a constitutional carry state,

* Expanding education freedom,

* Prohibiting land purchases by the CCP and related individuals and entities,

* Lowering prescription drug costs,

* Holding woke corporations and school unions accountable,

* Creating a universal school choice program,

* Delivering record-breaking tax relief,

* Helping families achieve the American dream of homeownership,

* Supporting law enforcement and our veterans,

* Enacting tougher penalties for drug dealers and sex offenders,

* Appointing seven conservative justices to the Florida Supreme Court,

* ...and so much more.

After leading Florida with common sense and conviction throughout his first term, DeSantis delivered a record-setting victory of nearly 20 points in 2022. He earned his second term by the largest raw vote margin in state history, winning by more than 1.5 million votes.

But history didn't stop there:

Governor DeSantis flipped Miami-Dade County red, winning the majority-Hispanic urban county by double digits. Conventional wisdom assumed this was impossible for a Republican - as recently as 2016, Hillary Clinton won Miami-Dade County by nearly 30 points.

Governor DeSantis flipped several other blue counties red, including Palm Beach County. He won 62 out of 67 counties overall.

Compared to his first statewide election in 2018, Governor DeSantis was up +19% with Independents, up +30% with Hispanics, and up +9% with women.

Governor DeSantis delivered a record-setting victory with battle-tested leadership, a bold policy agenda, and never backing down to corporate media or special interests. As he said at his inauguration: "When the world lost its mind - when common sense suddenly became an uncommon virtue - Florida was a refuge of sanity, a citadel of freedom for our fellow Americans and even for people around the world. In captaining the ship of state, we choose to navigate the boisterous sea of liberty rather than cower in the calm docks of despotism."

Governor DeSantis has ensured that Florida is a free and safe place to raise a family. Thanks to the governor's leadership, Floridians enjoy a low tax burden, quality education opportunities, and a bulwark in place against the Biden Administration's overreach and various elite power grabs that seek to force people to adopt a particular ideology. Thanks to the governor's vision, this year's legislative session delivered the most ambitious conservative policy victories in Florida's history.

This year, Governor DeSantis signed:
* Record tax relief

* ESG prohibitions

* Measures counteracting the influence of the CCP

* The strongest medical freedom protections in the nation.

* Reforms reducing the costs of medications by delivering transparency

* Bold higher education reforms; defunding DEI

* Improvements to our state's infrastructure

* Tough-on-crime, law and order measures, including the death penalty for child rapists

* The strongest measures protecting Florida from Biden's border crisis

* Reforms for paycheck protection , holding accountable wayward school unions

* Prohibitions on centralized digital currencies in Florida

No leader has accomplished more for his state than Governor DeSantis. He is now sharing his bold vision with the country, leading a movement to deliver the Great American Comeback.

subject: The truth about our emails:
body:
|
# [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/67194516/418944307/2043242937?refcode=em-header&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTMvMS85MzkwNSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIyNWFjMTYyNC02YzJkLWVlMTEtYjhmMC0wMDIyNDgzMmViNzMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=xx3UBtjlNEyyKCaQdc4uhfMluEt8aqI6k4KJ-f4dxv4=)
Peter,

Before I ran for Congress, I remember getting bombarded with non-stop, hair-on-fire emails from political campaigns.

**To be honest, I often tuned them out.** The deadlines seemed arbitrary, and they were full of obnoxious scare tactics. In my view, Democratic donors have plenty of _real_ reasons why they should support our cause. Resorting to exaggerations and desperation is just counterproductive.

That's why my team and I do things differently. Yes, the stakes are high, but we won't feed into the panic you might see on social media or cable news. As a lifelong meteorologist, I value facts -- not hype.

# _'Bidenomics' Strikes Again_
---
Earlier this month, President Joe Biden claimed that "Bidenomics" is "just another way of saying restoring the American Dream.” Yet, his policies have made that very dream increasingly out of reach for millions of Americans. Just a few months ago, Treasury Secretary Janet Yellen confirmed as much, agreeing that President Biden's inflationary spending set the stage for the Federal Reserve to need to increase interest rates. And just this week, they did it again, raising rates for the 11th time to their highest level in over two decades. Now, prices aren't just higher, but borrowing to afford them is, too. Homeownership, long a central tenet of the American Dream that President Biden claims he is restoring, has become more difficult, as the average 30-year mortgage rate has been pushed above 7 percent for the first time in years. But it's not just mortgages ... auto loans, credit cards ... everything is just more expensive. This is "Bidenomics" in action, and we can't afford four more years of it. We hope you'll join us in working to make Joe Biden a one-term president next year. Sincerely,
---

Chairman Kyle Hupfer

# _Kicking Off the 2023 State Fair_
---

| | _**Governor Eric Holcomb** provides remarks at the opening of the 166th Indiana State Fair._**
---
**Governor Eric Holcomb** joined others to officially kick off the 166th Indiana State Fair today.
* The fair's theme this year is "Celebrating Basketball: The State That Grew the Game."

**Timeout: Gov. Holcomb** is a big fan of basketball, having made a basket in all of Indiana's 92 counties.
**What he’s saying:** “This morning we officially opened the Indiana State Fair for the best 18 days of summer," **Gov. Holcomb** stated in a social media post today.
* "I cannot wait to see what all the 2023 Indiana State Fair has to offer. I have a feeling that this year's fair is going to be a _slam dunk_ ," he added.

**Catch up:** Last week, **Gov. Holcomb** joined other state and agricultural leaders to cut the ribbon on the Indiana State Fairgrounds’ new Indiana Farm Bureau Fall Creek Pavillion.
* The indoor complex is the result of a multi-year renovation of the fairgrounds' century-old swine barn.

# _National Review: McCarthy: Hunter Biden’s Sweetheart Plea Deal Blows Up_

"This was one of the questions I was naturally asked while doing some legal analysis of the Delaware Demolition in which Hunter Biden’s sweetheart plea deal went up in smoke on Wednesday. "My reply: 'Go to trial . . . _on what?'_ "That should be a dumb question to which the usual answer is, “The indictment, of course.” But see, here’s the thing: President Biden’s Justice Department has never filed an indictment against President Biden’s son. Why? Well, for the same reason the sweetheart deal blew up. The fatal flaw of the agreement written by Biden prosecutors is that it failed to describe in detail the criminal charges for which Hunter Biden was receiving immunity. _[Column continues](http://ci.criticalimpact.com/go/1/f7f15e9875c39250df60ac364a9f256a/40313/dd7d9cd20834d84e/73ad30cbb90a043ac3d6b838967d376c/40313).[](http://ci.criticalimpact.com/go/1/f7f15e9875c39250df60ac364a9f256a/40313/dd7d9cd20834d84e/fb96e52d6c212d64c3d6b838967d376c/40313)_

# _Indiana Capital Chronicle: 'Game Changer' Bill Aims to Revolutionize Mental Health Care System_
---
From _[Indiana Capital Chronicle](http://ci.criticalimpact.com/go/1/f7f15e9875c39250df60ac364a9f256a/40313/dd7d9cd20834d84e/4b3937bb28f2030dc3d6b838967d376c/40313)_ : "Several weeks ago, Porter-Starke Services — one of Indiana’s 24 community mental health clinics — received a call. A person was experiencing a mental health crisis and was suicidal, but the office was closing. "The only option left was Starke County’s hospital, which Sandy Carlson, Porter-Starke’s vice president of clinical services, said is small and not equipped to manage psychiatric patients. A crisis that began around 5 p.m. took until the early morning hours to stabilize the patient through hospitalization. "But under the mental health care transformation shepherded by Senate Enrolled Act 1, the individual could have gotten the help they needed in a more efficient and effective way." _[Story continues](http://ci.criticalimpact.com/go/1/f7f15e9875c39250df60ac364a9f256a/40313/dd7d9cd20834d84e/1456bd10838a8913c3d6b838967d376c/40313)[](http://ci.criticalimpact.com/go/1/f7f15e9875c39250df60ac364a9f256a/40313/dd7d9cd20834d84e/9d177400d4953722c3d6b838967d376c/40313).__

# _SEA 35 Will Improve Financial Literacy for Young Hoosiers_
---
During the 2023 session, the legislature passed, and **Governor Holcomb** signed,**** SEA 35, placing Indiana among the states that guarantee a personal financial literacy class for all high school graduates.** ** **The details:** SEA 35 requires high school students, beginning with the class of 2028, to successfully complete a personal financial literacy course in order to graduate.
* “It’s important for every student to have this. I think it will pay in dividends throughout the rest of their lives," said state **Sen. Mike Gaskill**.

# _Biden is Manufacturing Half Truths _
---
From [_FactCheckBiden.com_](http://ci.criticalimpact.com/go/1/f7f15e9875c39250df60ac364a9f256a/40313/dd7d9cd20834d84e/4831aedb263b0aecc3d6b838967d376c/40313): In his latest absurd claim, President Joe Biden wants Americans to believe that he has created more jobs in a single four-year term than any other president. Yet, Biden’s numbers ignore that 80% of the jobs he claims to have “created” were recovered when Americans returned to work post-Covid.

**Swing and a miss:** Biden’s failed economic agenda has been much more of a bust than a boom for manufacturing workers in critical swing states.
* In Pennsylvania, Biden claims to have “created” 28,000 new manufacturing jobs - but the truth is Biden has created [zero](http://ci.criticalimpact.com/go/1/f7f15e9875c39250df60ac364a9f256a/40313/dd7d9cd20834d84e/dab7e8c055893250c3d6b838967d376c/40313) “new” jobs in the Keystone State that didn’t exist before the COVID-19 pandemic.
* In Wisconsin, Biden claims to have “created” 20,000 new manufacturing jobs - but the truth is [over 80 percent](http://ci.criticalimpact.com/go/1/f7f15e9875c39250df60ac364a9f256a/40313/dd7d9cd20834d84e/0a1545d3fbef699ac3d6b838967d376c/40313) of those jobs in the Badger State were recovered from reopening the economy after the COVID-19 pandemic.

Not only are manufacturing numbers worse than Biden has projected, shrinking activity is leading to [factory layoffs](http://ci.criticalimpact.com/go/1/f7f15e9875c39250df60ac364a9f256a/40313/dd7d9cd20834d84e/ed4151ae7b276e38c3d6b838967d376c/40313) and growing concerns that manufacturing is [in a recession](http://ci.criticalimpact.com/go/1/f7f15e9875c39250df60ac364a9f256a/40313/dd7d9cd20834d84e/16717a3a3c5d9130c3d6b838967d376c/40313). **What is true: **Bidenomics has not led to a manufacturing boom, it has led to [higher costs and lower wages](http://ci.criticalimpact.com/go/1/f7f15e9875c39250df60ac364a9f256a/40313/dd7d9cd20834d84e/84c1da412624d95cc3d6b838967d376c/40313).

body:
I’m starting to worry about our budget.
# [](https://act.lateefahsimon.com/go/39?t=1&akid=70%2E1163%2EVNPBwZ)
Hey! This is Zoë, Lateefah's Campaign Manager.
The first thing I did when I got on the ground in March was to build our campaign plan. Campaign plans are comprehensive paths to victory -- but, by far, the most critical piece of the plan is our campaign budget.
Our budget is a roadmap of what we think we need to spend in order to win, and it's informed by our monthly revenue. **Right now, we're falling short of our monthly internal goal for digital fundraising by $3,298.**
**[Will you chip in $10 today to help us reach our July end-of-month goal? Every dollar we raise helps us keep building this people-powered movement.](https://act.lateefahsimon.com/go/143?t=2&akid=70%2E1163%2EVNPBwZ)**

So far, Team Lateefah has been crushing it: showing up in big numbers to our launch event, signing up to volunteer by the dozens, and chipping in to power our campaign operations in a big way.
**But we can't lose sight of the fact that we're running in a highly competitive primary.** Lateefah will only be our progressive voice in Congress if we keep up our momentum and are able to keep pace with all of our opponents.
So, I'm personally asking our grassroots supporters like you: **[Can you make your first contribution to our campaign today to keep building this movement?](https://act.lateefahsimon.com/go/143?t=3&akid=70%2E1163%2EVNPBwZ)**

name: Colin Allred
subject: Friend, this race is personal
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Robert Garcia for Congress
body:
#
_Congressman Robert Garcia is proud to support Colin Allred in his race to unseat Ted Cruz in Texas’ Senate race. Please see a message from Colin below and contribute to his critical campaign if you can:_
Friend, I'm running to defeat Ted Cruz because this fight is personal for me. I'd love to take a moment to explain why.
I'm a fourth-generation Texan. I'm the proud son of a single mom who taught in public schools and sometimes worked a second job just to make ends meet.
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/67195684/418948106/1855133154?refcode2=d47d375d-6f2d-ee11-b8f0-00224832eb73&refcode=em230728-1-t1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MTcxOSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJkNDdkMzc1ZC02ZjJkLWVlMTEtYjhmMC0wMDIyNDgzMmViNzMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=GGzzbc99s53tYACCxV-c_85lIHWdcHreJRg6o1gSZW8=)
Growing up, my world was pretty small. I never imagined I'd be working in the halls of Congress let alone taking on Ted Cruz, hoping to become the first Black senator from Texas. But I did dream of helping people – whether it was as Superman or a firefighter.
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/67195685/418948107/1855133154?refcode2=d47d375d-6f2d-ee11-b8f0-00224832eb73&refcode=em230728-1-t1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MTcxOSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJkNDdkMzc1ZC02ZjJkLWVlMTEtYjhmMC0wMDIyNDgzMmViNzMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=GGzzbc99s53tYACCxV-c_85lIHWdcHreJRg6o1gSZW8=)
After playing football at Baylor University and in the NFL, I went to law school and became a civil rights attorney, specializing in voting rights. I've watched this fundamental right be attacked and eroded my whole life – right here in Texas we have some of the most restrictive voter laws in the country, and it's no secret that these laws target Black and brown voters.
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/67195686/418948108/1855133154?refcode2=d47d375d-6f2d-ee11-b8f0-00224832eb73&refcode=em230728-1-t1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MTcxOSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJkNDdkMzc1ZC02ZjJkLWVlMTEtYjhmMC0wMDIyNDgzMmViNzMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=GGzzbc99s53tYACCxV-c_85lIHWdcHreJRg6o1gSZW8=)
**It was one of the great honors of my life that one of my heroes and a voting rights and American giant, Congressman John Lewis, joined me on the campaign trail in 2018. I beat the odds – and an 11-term GOP incumbent – to win that race and help Democrats flip the House. Now I'm ready to do it again and replace Ted Cruz in the U.S. Senate – but I need your help.[That's why I'm asking you to split a donation between my campaign and Robert Garcia today →](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/67195687/418948109/1855133154?refcode2=d47d375d-6f2d-ee11-b8f0-00224832eb73&refcode=em230728-1-t1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MTcxOSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJkNDdkMzc1ZC02ZjJkLWVlMTEtYjhmMC0wMDIyNDgzMmViNzMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=GGzzbc99s53tYACCxV-c_85lIHWdcHreJRg6o1gSZW8=)**
We've all watched for 10 years as Ted Cruz has failed the people of Texas repeatedly. He's bowed down to Donald Trump, pushed dangerous conspiracy theories about the 2020 elections, cheered on the rioters that stormed the Capitol on Jan. 6 and abandoned our state while Texans froze in the dark. To add insult to injury, after we passed critical voting rights legislation in the House, he spearheaded the effort to kill it in the Senate.
**Time and time again, Ted Cruz has made it clear he will always put Ted Cruz first. That's not me. I'm running for Senate to be a voice for all Texans, for families like yours and mine, and I hope you'll help me get there, friend. Because the truth is, unseating Ted Cruz won't be easy. It's possible, if we all work together and amass a grassroots movement like Texas has never seen, but I need you with me.**
**[So please, will you split a donation of $5, $10 or whatever you can between my campaign and Robert Garcia to help me defeat Ted Cruz, flip Texas blue and expand our Democratic Senate majority? Every dollar makes a difference in our battleground race, and I truly appreciate it →](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/67195688/418948110/1855133154?refcode2=d47d375d-6f2d-ee11-b8f0-00224832eb73&refcode=em230728-1-t1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MTcxOSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJkNDdkMzc1ZC02ZjJkLWVlMTEtYjhmMC0wMDIyNDgzMmViNzMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=GGzzbc99s53tYACCxV-c_85lIHWdcHreJRg6o1gSZW8=)**
Thanks for reading my story – and for being on my team. I can't tell you what it means to have you with me in this fight from the very beginning.
Colin Allred
**[DONATE>>](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/67195689/418948111/1855133154?refcode2=d47d375d-6f2d-ee11-b8f0-00224832eb73&refcode=em230728-1-t1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MTcxOSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJkNDdkMzc1ZC02ZjJkLWVlMTEtYjhmMC0wMDIyNDgzMmViNzMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=GGzzbc99s53tYACCxV-c_85lIHWdcHreJRg6o1gSZW8=)**

Derek, it’s Chrissy, and I’m still _fuming_ _._ I thought I had seen the ugliest parts of the far right's bigotry – but I was evidently wrong.
Last week, Republicans (unanimously) took the unprecedented step of gutting almost _$4 million_ for vital social services for LGBTQ Americans in need. The money was for transitional housing and other related support!
**I’m devastated to say that included my own request for much-needed support in our own community** – a project that has the power to transform and save so many young lives.
But this decision isn’t rooted in any legitimacy – instead _it’s rooted in bigotry._ For some Republicans, their hatred knows no bounds. While this charge was first led by just a few extremists, the larger Republican Caucus ultimately stood by and let them do it.

Bill grew up in Baton Rouge, Louisiana, and is a proud LSU graduate. He worked in Louisiana’s charity hospital system for over 25 years, ensuring that the less fortunate in our state were able to receive quality health care. Later, Bill co-founded the Greater Baton Rouge Community Clinic, providing free dental and health care to working families without insurance. In the wake of Hurricane Katrina, Bill led a group of volunteers to convert an abandoned K-Mart building into an emergency healthcare facility.
As a conservative in the Senate, he focuses on the issues Louisiana families care about the most. Bill is working to lower the cost of health care, make flood insurance affordable, and save Social Security from a 24% cut if Washington fails to act.
Bill, and his wife, Laura, live in Baton Rouge and attend church at the Chapel on the Campus. They are blessed with three children and one grandchild.

# Allek Pastrana Hosts Campaign Kickoff For Congressional District 7 Race
---
| | |
---
| | | |
---
| | | | **Sanford, FL** \- Allek Pastrana, a passionate father and progressive Democrat with a distinguished background in information security, is thrilled to announce the official launch of his congressional campaign. The campaign kickoff event will take place on July 31st at Buster's Bistro, located at 300 S Sanford Ave in Sanford, FL, and will commence at 7 PM. The campaign kickoff promises to be a momentous occasion, bringing together community members, supporters, and activists who share Allek Pastrana's vision for a brighter and more inclusive future. The event will offer an opportunity for attendees to connect with Allek personally and gain insights into his innovative policy proposals that aim to create positive change in our community. As an experienced professional in the field of information security, Allek Pastrana brings a unique perspective to the political arena. His commitment to safeguarding data and protecting individual privacy reflects his core values of integrity and empathy, which he promises to carry with him into public service. "I am excited to embark on this journey with fellow citizens who believe in the power of progress and the value of inclusivity," said Allek Pastrana. "Together, we will strive to build a more secure and prosperous future for all, where every voice is heard and represented in Congress to update Florida." In addition to his expertise in information security, Allek Pastrana is deeply dedicated to championing a range of critical issues, such as affordable healthcare, comprehensive immigration reform, sustainable environmental policies, and access to quality education. The campaign kickoff at Buster's Bistro will mark the beginning of an inspiring and community-driven movement that seeks to bring changes to update Florida.

Over 38k comments against MVP Southgate submitted to FERC!
---
Earlier this week, the FERC (Federal Energy Regulatory Commision) public comment window for MVP Southgate’s certificate extension closed. If granted, the FERC certificate would allow Southgate developers to begin condemning private property along the route through eminent domain. **Over 38k comments were submitted against the project, including letters of opposition from Gov. Cooper and 50 NC state legislators.** Thank you to everyone who participated! FERC is likely to announce their decision in the coming weeks. Stay tuned.

Peter: During my time as president of Planned Parenthood, I watched Republicans attempt to pass horrific laws to control women's bodies.

But now, with Roe v. Wade no longer the law of the land, I need to be blunt with you: **Anti-choice extremists are attacking abortion access _like never before._**

In states across this country, Republicans are doing everything in their power to restrict reproductive freedom – and Mitch McConnell and his allies have threatened to pass a national abortion ban if they take back Senate control.

Political analysts say that the future of the Senate could all come down to Nevada – just like it did last year – which is why I’m reaching out today: **My friend, Sen. Jacky Rosen, is running for reelection. I’m working hard to help her win this fight, and I’m asking you to join me.**

The GOP knows the importance of Nevada, so they’re zeroing in on Jacky as a top target for defeat. She’s facing an uphill climb and won’t be able to defend her seat without grassroots support from people like you. **So please, Peter, I’m personally asking:[_Will you chip in $10 – split between Jacky’s campaign and Fight for Progress or more now – to keep Nevada blue, defend the Senate, and restore reproductive freedom nationwide?_](https://click.everyaction.com/k/67201181/418965720/-220169546?refcode=BLU-FFP-20230728-1-EM&amount=10&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAwNS8xLzc3NDA2IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImNmN2JjOGY0LTdiMmQtZWUxMS1iOGYwLTAwMjI0ODMyZWI3MyIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=yHjBW9aAGfPGZC2QPEN6wtezJgVYkSY2Cr5eehH5Egc=)**
