body:
So I want to tell you about the burn pit I lived next to in Iraq — and how politicians like Josh Hawley failed veterans like me.
#
Peter — one year ago today, Josh Hawley and 40 other Republicans blocked a bill to expand healthcare to millions of veterans like me who were exposed to toxic burn pits during their service.
[](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/35283?refcode=em20230728-3464&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1&akid=3464%2E614464%2E7tXm_f)
In a moment, I’m going to ask you to **[make your first donation of any amount toward our end-of-month goal of raising $50,000 before August 1.](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/35283?refcode=em20230728-3464&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=2&akid=3464%2E614464%2E7tXm_f) But first, I want to tell you about the burn pit I lived next to in Iraq — and how politicians like Josh Hawley failed veterans like me.**
**[ADD A DONATION NOW »](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/35283?refcode=em20230728-3464&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=3&akid=3464%2E614464%2E7tXm_f)**
It was 2009. I was stationed at the Al Taqaddum Airbase where I was a Marine Captain leading a police training team. Twelve Marines and a Navy Corpsman. Running missions through Habbaniyah, Fallujah, and Ramadi.
It was my first of three tours of duty during the War on Terror. And from our camp, the base’s burn pit loomed over us.
[](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/35283?refcode=em20230728-3464&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=4&akid=3464%2E614464%2E7tXm_f)
Smoke columns filled the sky and blew through our living space. We ran through it, joking about how we should be doing gas mask runs. For three months that pit bathed us in toxic fumes. We accepted it and focused on our duty.
For me, that was planning our routes and pouring over intel to avoid the immediate danger: IEDs on all the convoys and missions we were running outside the wire. I was so proud to bring every member of that team home safely.
**Or so I thought — because, as it turns out, we couldn’t protect ourselves from our own country.**
When I got back from Iraq, I developed a persistent tickle in my throat. Constant irritation. I never had allergies before and annoyed myself with the constant throat clearing. Eventually, I was so embarrassed by it that I went to the base clinic. They said it was postnasal drip and that they could give me allergy medicine. There was no formal diagnosis. But over 10 years later, it’s still there.
Bothersome. Uncomfortable, but certainly manageable. And that’s about the best story you’ll hear about a vet who’s been exposed to burn pits. Many struggle with chronic respiratory issues. Migraines. Cancer.
So imagine how we all felt, watching all these Republicans like Josh Hawley, most of whom have never even worn the uniform, throw us a giant middle finger?
I know that’s harsh language, but it has to be. Because what they did was about as anti-American as it gets. Patriots don’t attack veterans who suffered injuries or illness from being around those toxic pits.
Many of these same Republicans spent years voting to keep us in these forever wars, lying to the American people about what was really going on over there, and getting rich off their defense contractor stocks that skyrocket when we’re at war.
These people profited off of sending us over there only to screw us when we came back messed up. **It’s criminal — and I’m ready to do something about it.**
I served my country for 13 years in the United States Marine Corps. I’d give anything for this country — and that’s exactly why I’m running to replace Josh Hawley in the U.S. Senate.
**We deserve leaders who are willing to make even an ounce of the sacrifice our veterans have.[If you’re with me, please add a donation of $10 or anything at all to my grassroots campaign today so we can hit our end-of-month goal, get this message in front of Missouri voters, and defeat Josh Hawley in 2024.](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/35283?refcode=em20230728-3464&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=5&akid=3464%2E614464%2E7tXm_f)**
If you've stored your info with ActBlue Express, we'll process your contribution instantly:
[Contribute $10](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/35284?refcode=em20230728-3464&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amount=10&t=6&akid=3464%2E614464%2E7tXm_f) [Contribute $25](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/35284?refcode=em20230728-3464&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amount=25&t=7&akid=3464%2E614464%2E7tXm_f) [Contribute $30](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/35284?refcode=em20230728-3464&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amount=30&t=8&akid=3464%2E614464%2E7tXm_f) [Contribute $50](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/35284?refcode=em20230728-3464&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amount=50&t=9&akid=3464%2E614464%2E7tXm_f) [Contribute $100](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/35284?refcode=em20230728-3464&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amount=100&t=10&akid=3464%2E614464%2E7tXm_f) [Contribute $250](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/35284?refcode=em20230728-3464&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amount=250&t=11&akid=3464%2E614464%2E7tXm_f) [Give another amount](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/35283?refcode=em20230728-3464&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=12&akid=3464%2E614464%2E7tXm_f)

— Lucas Kunce

body:

Dear Friend,
As part of our July fundraising challenge, we’re making it clear to everyone that Scott Perry is the most dangerous member of Congress. First up, why Scott Perry is a threat to our national security.
If you already understand how dangerous Perry is, and you agree that we MUST defeat him next year, CLICK HERE to make a contribution to help us reach our fundraising challenge goal and our donors will match your contribution [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/sdemail2023]
Scott Perry and his Freedom Caucus have turned the National Defense Authorization Act (NDAA), which has always enjoyed bipartisan consensus about the need to fund our military, into a battlefield in his culture war. Now, vital defense spending has become a vicious partisan debate, and Perry has promised not to back down from his extremist stance. Check out the video to hear it in his own words.
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=e-EKAGJiXHk [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=e-EKAGJiXHk]
Using national security as red meat for his radical base is unacceptable. Our military needs to be concerned about the actual battlefield, not Perry’s culture war. Donate now to help us defeat Perry. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/sdemail2023]
Each year, the National Defense Authorization Act (NDAA) authorizes funding levels and provides authority for the U.S. military and other critical defense priorities, ensuring America's forces have the training, equipment, and resources they need to carry out their missions.
it's no wonder why it has always enjoyed broad, bipartisan support, that is until Perry decided to use it as a bargaining chip to push his extreme agenda.
We cannot tolerate members of Congress who jeopardize the safety and security of our nation in the name of extremism. That’s why you need to click here to make a donation to help us defeat Scott Perry. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/sdemail2023]

Click here to make a contribution to our campaign today, and we will defeat Perry TOGETHER [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/sdemail2023]
In our next installment, we will tell you about the ways Scott Perry has threatened our economic security. In the meantime, stay tuned to the upcoming debate over passage of the NDAA as Perry and his extremist cronies try to hold the House, the Senate and our country hostage to their radical beliefs.
With Gratitude,
Shamaine

| | What a whirlwind! We’ve been talking about all things unidentified anomalous phenomena (UAP) on [Fox News](http://links.burchettforcongress.com/u/click?_t=feefb5ad83f24ba4b99ac997c1b47e86&_m=dc01b13bbc644f33b1069c7881630a87&_e=ekIw4_6wAkkPOuDc7yaryPx9wyQT3Xoj7Cv5fk8nnhh_LuEhsw_E9-PQTSDlacuI7i6Aqp6eXvH_2EZ92vfmwAOulnWXBnJ0qNqlz9vwvx8whu7WtYdLR259ZoVDNxx8u-YO0ONhj9Zrwpe_ycd_k-qTuJIfpAK0UEaEmOF7AKiOFyRCkpSd2cQ5u5w6kwW8JAaysdZnZI_vldG5Zq-wsWgyp3XTNgYCalm_WWWkKtQ%3D), [C-SPAN](http://links.burchettforcongress.com/u/click?_t=feefb5ad83f24ba4b99ac997c1b47e86&_m=dc01b13bbc644f33b1069c7881630a87&_e=ekIw4_6wAkkPOuDc7yaryJSybeJFryRHnbkZyTmgAzKylHjGTcF-KBFavRX6qa9AafVM_XW7w7yGYsVBNEvvZDGYNQ7jKR1Ju_WLj1li819lUVlkTRZ-hnoyAN6t76I3uu81-03k6eJI161afa1th0MCYXyQeHftWl3wicvOLCBEv3TgrJPMY3NDiJbh3abIy57poaq8KrXYFOwPDVQ1SRwmijiarbw5UjfZEQXwBYyHYgQMalJ866IHHDzqe62_jT93yTCB2Ksh6-5RPzbux2DqoFPxAhDiSeoqwo9Y4IeOvfNXWk9KVzybwGuBycr1), [Newsmax](http://links.burchettforcongress.com/u/click?_t=feefb5ad83f24ba4b99ac997c1b47e86&_m=dc01b13bbc644f33b1069c7881630a87&_e=ekIw4_6wAkkPOuDc7yaryKOgcFb99C07FxeTBy2j1X9ZtlraCo6shb-3-sl7ThTEJIzvJzKFtJXoiVkiyR4BRSn1z2GDeV50DM1SBJZoa1pG12kk4ldABFfbkH1T6uKPW8rSt-B17yyKniqMyLcGOo2UnscJJsYxHZ4p9A1rRygR9VliwY4PXb7QOOqcHmKIerXwuW0gpL0s626klecg6qYP-CZwqZHgWZLJ-v2gEhOFmgPcRSwC7DIWKDd9TD4erro8Tiy2QHHuzq9flK2s7A%3D%3D), and more for the past few days—and I’m not stopping anytime soon. But rest assured, as your congressman, with the same Tennessee grit and determination that defines us, I'm continuing to roll up my sleeves and fight for all the other pressing matters that impact us right here in East Tennessee. Working alongside Congressman Steve Cohen, we're fighting the good fight for transparency by introducing a measure to [uncover the salaries](http://links.burchettforcongress.com/u/click?_t=feefb5ad83f24ba4b99ac997c1b47e86&_m=dc01b13bbc644f33b1069c7881630a87&_e=ekIw4_6wAkkPOuDc7yaryC8815jv2lbsPffBDcI-xIppbSVsc0FjAE0kb4Vr_UZslHC60JvY1l-Eec4nx8xacfm4BLKsBzfIv8HoTgdepQZf6HP68Wfr-_18Va5j_1pxrr0HNC6pKIKlLwGgMEKZyLhDQ5CfQpQU7NO_OPoblR2mdGmpmg9W2JZEzE7Wls14DZZifWtFad-dvYm7E0cwpGVLD1y8ZsocMEM1Fl9dcloxMMC5PtEtIz22Q9raoR-QFOopSWmnp3vFxH4_PN-6hQ%3D%3D) of Tennessee Valley Authority (TVA) employees earning six figures and beyond. The revelations have been eye-opening, with the TVA CEO topping the charts as the highest paid federal government employee, raking in a whopping [$9.8 million](http://links.burchettforcongress.com/u/click?_t=feefb5ad83f24ba4b99ac997c1b47e86&_m=dc01b13bbc644f33b1069c7881630a87&_e=ekIw4_6wAkkPOuDc7yaryKV6gVKJpc5jsbwxnb3u03gdU4IUYhpM3JwEiczuvLicfT53R8ngkr0GjW3jOqszFTn28Vfxj7zhmqaLDFjEyPfEJElOtWFKMP9GF8WONykoFTGhYNH_mbmSxfw_HnFwyK9Vhk6TYH8mJirAf2owyc5otbTrup61ju9Ze4xlRufIKfqupan5TSkUQ8H94fk1PfGlbKAuBY4gnmkb8STwplr4-WcR9ArI0TNx00ei4OdaFk7jJcike-LFRkFZu1Nac9Whvql2IUNCOJgfhPY4EAk%3D) last year. Give me a break. Salary abuses are rampant when it comes to government folks, which is why we’re working overtime to bring these numbers into the light. While I’ve seen the TVA [improve its transparency](http://links.burchettforcongress.com/u/click?_t=feefb5ad83f24ba4b99ac997c1b47e86&_m=dc01b13bbc644f33b1069c7881630a87&_e=ekIw4_6wAkkPOuDc7yaryIocpnVJDDCvx2uBtGHcb1o6jvzbU57l5PsAM2tqu9jj6P4Nix-ituRNAudQR3c6_RLTERo2JGyr-5TeXDrsHYR8bCyz_N99FyD_YJWIH278YDGPtiUDjI8oPWmVNlAEi4gkIDq4KKQC0GhcVIZyHQXbjNgAs_qySS-XwsRr5RVGrmljGVJmAKLwGSW5Q7CXy1ICVHdKi6U3diYH_ePwjSm09yer4rmjmlqeaCk23fgpwXHhXYqq0uC4AgIOrVjXRqbSlKhZRDI3cPsf-IfQlPPrVn7pYpCIehfeuWic5tumC3SPGfN8QgVfIvN1KMLWlrtX-zgna5LF9EI3g6_UF6wQdIbJjZnIwOe_xnkWDGrc) in recent years, it isn’t enough. By championing openness and accountability, we're setting an example for responsible governance and making darn sure that the interests of the public always come first. And lastly, I want to make one thing crystal clear—I haven't forgotten about the Biden crime family. These crooks keep [making headlines](http://links.burchettforcongress.com/u/click?_t=feefb5ad83f24ba4b99ac997c1b47e86&_m=dc01b13bbc644f33b1069c7881630a87&_e=ekIw4_6wAkkPOuDc7yaryPx9wyQT3Xoj7Cv5fk8nnhjMm36IOoIDHlNRlVxUF8YxGwQqrCNwqP5B8o6zvpHIfSGS2t3C7Xeeothu2PXBQRLXqeRMCMJoNOnuVN57JdCAPdcqK9m1h0GIeXQP9yUlmGsn-XnSwlEHhy6ChEL6TSmGD0kTrFvJCG-XdiQ95EH95W7EUJPmcYMN-R1NXHQ3NoIB_MPXqucd3zrWmUxoDgAgdncX1Z0UDEfTMfVewuCXpNhcWi0VYJ3l3_yFSh7qdWOsOPECMouEy7fgefMbUHY%3D), and let me tell you, I won't turn a blind eye to their shenanigans—not now, not ever. | | Nothing captivates and motivates kids quite like a puppy, and Rosie is doing the job well. The Public Defender’s Office in Knox County offers an [after-school reading program](http://links.burchettforcongress.com/u/click?_t=feefb5ad83f24ba4b99ac997c1b47e86&_m=dc01b13bbc644f33b1069c7881630a87&_e=ekIw4_6wAkkPOuDc7yaryFWN-70xUf335mURi4jj46aIvpjY4EyvZR599YjSeXAUwgrOBXkLu8q_UUiU_1ExkfpnkBA8TEJXwdvWKlMeJdKAae0JfvVqWUigYH3feyodkCgMhxTt3thAcueeOO4yOvu_LthT_vYnfiyUXVjnRq9FpikzTgYtTv5qUryvV2nSqEnv4HA-jLwlQtrHXVhaS_IYyCUyGLCSV4XmNcwJM4VYo3s-Dy4KYcYOX03UhTCpmwBrYeJjufwntBahlfg83v2gTMJ7oyKoww73xeQfSiydpgNIJG1U40IhNuam4h8G) with a trained support dog to promote literacy. The idea to incorporate dogs was born out of a need to create excitement around reading. They had a bus dropping kids off, and plenty of tutors to go around, but the children weren’t excited or focused. Today, all that has changed with Rosie around. Rosie’s handler says she’s a part of [Habit](http://links.burchettforcongress.com/u/click?_t=feefb5ad83f24ba4b99ac997c1b47e86&_m=dc01b13bbc644f33b1069c7881630a87&_e=ekIw4_6wAkkPOuDc7yaryKfZkcW7mfcClW45GyG1TF7au6s130EYNpm1Qr-JeSIxslc5qsbA3IWgWC3x67ajGxNnBxFTOrpdpBV-PrhVPRxb7cWOTvM1V9Vcl15fbSJJ9qpviSHfLHCrTVGJk8LtLF-hYWtwh8lMkin2XIR0GyvhqKBc8u0eWgyHTsy5lgo3SLAzrK1TKUbRO0LPF4OZ7SiFGzvzlWWYnS6bswcpJaY%3D), a group designed to promote the valuable bond between people and animals. And this isn’t the reading program’s first Habit dog. Inside the reading room is a sketch that honors the memory of June Bug, another dog who helped kids learn to love reading. Leave it to the people of Tennessee to get creative when it comes to giving kids the tools they need to succeed! Your dedication is commendable.

body:
https://rokhanna.com [https://rokhanna.com]

Friend,
Since the 2020 election, the right to vote has been under attack in state legislatures nationwide. States like Florida and Texas have passed sweeping legislation aimed at “voter fraud” that disproportionately impacts young voters and communities of color. Republican lawmakers have closed polling stations, created hurdles for voter registration, rejected ballots for arcane rule violations, and removed hundreds of thousands of people in voter purges.

And the assault on voting rights isn’t limited to state legislatures. House Republicans recently introduced the American Confidence in Elections Act [https://thehill.com/homenews/house/4089394-house-gop-election-reform-bill/] , a thinly-veiled effort to suppress the vote while also giving billionaires and corporations even more influence in our elections.

That’s why we need the Freedom to Vote Act [https://www.brennancenter.org/our-work/research-reports/freedom-vote-act] . This legislation would protect and expand the right to vote nationwide through automatic voter registration, expanded early and mail-in voting, and protections against voter ID laws targeting vulnerable Americans. The bill also targets dark money through strengthened campaign finance transparency measures and addresses tactics used in efforts to undermine the 2020 election.

Tell Congress: Pass the Freedom to Vote Act. [https://actionnetwork.org/forms/sign-the-petition-to-congress-pass-the-freedom-to-vote-act-2?source=2023FTVA_RKC&referrer=group-ro-khanna&redirect=https%3A%2F%2Fsecure.actblue.com%2Fdonate%2Fdk-freedom-to-vote-act-petition-swap]

Sign the Petition [https://actionnetwork.org/forms/sign-the-petition-to-congress-pass-the-freedom-to-vote-act-2?source=2023FTVA_RKC&referrer=group-ro-khanna&redirect=https%3A%2F%2Fsecure.actblue.com%2Fdonate%2Fdk-freedom-to-vote-act-petition-swap]

Congress has a responsibility to defend democracy for the very people who elected us to represent them. By passing the Freedom to Vote Act, we are fulfilling that promise.

In solidarity,
Ro

name: Kennedy Democrats
subject: Progress Together Come November
body:
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP25/1/106220/images/KD_Logo.png]
Friend,
As we stand at the crossroads of progress and regression, the future of our great commonwealth lies in our hands. Pennsylvania has always been a reflection of the nation. Our economy strong, our landscape diverse, and our people resilient––our Commonwealth is a microcosm of the nation as a whole. As such, we bear the great responsibility of leading the greatest nation on earth, and as citizens of this Commonwealth, we are often asked to put our hands on the direction of leadership at the ballot box.
This November, the leadership of our citizens will be as important as ever. Candidates like Daniel McCafferey are running for the Supreme Court to protect reproductive rights, democracy, and freedom of speech. Dozens of countywide races are being held in Pittsburgh, Allegheny, Bucks, Erie, and all counties across the Commonwealth. Reproductive freedom is on the ballot, whether in a Supreme Court race or constitutional referendum, voters all over the country and across party lines have overwhelmingly embraced freedom, in states as diverse as Kansas, Kentucky, Wisconsin, and Michigan.
With these issues on the ballot, your support matters.
When you invest in Democratic candidates, you are investing in a Pennsylvania that fights for the working class, for teachers, for the environment, and does so with integrity and vigor.
Together, whether it be today or come November, we can make a difference. We can ensure that Pennsylvania reflects upon our nation with pride and with strength. We can ensure that our Commonwealth upholds the values of liberty and justice. We can do this by investing in our candidates, by knocking doors, by talking to friends, and by voting
Every investment of money, time, or your vote has a significant impact on the future of the Commonwealth and the nation. Please consider supporting.
Sincerely,
Scott Wallace
Kennedy Democrats Co-Founder

We're using the full power of our team to continue building our progressive base all across the country, Peter. clean_body: Cori is unafraid to stand for the people. | | Peter, Cori Bush doesn’t want anyone else to have to go through what she’s gone through. That’s what fuels her activism and her policymaking, and it’s why she speaks up for people who have felt voiceless. She’s been assaulted by the police. She’s been evicted and forced out onto the streets to live in a car with her two children. As Cori has said, she wouldn’t wish these traumas on anybody. That’s why she camped out on the steps of Congress day and night and succeeded in delaying evictions for millions of Americans. And it’s why for years, Cori has spoken out against the Israeli government for stealing and destroying Palestinians’ homes while brutalizing and killing Palestinian families. Cori cares about people, governing from a place of radical love for all humanity. That threatens right-wing groups like AIPAC, which want to maintain the status quo. AIPAC and its affiliated groups have spent millions to defeat progressive women of color, including Cori—even though women of color running for federal office often have much less cash on hand than other candidates.[1] We don’t take money from corporate PACs, instead relying on grassroots donations from people like you in order to keep Cori in Congress fighting for all of us. As the first member of the movement for Black Lives to be elected to Congress, Cori is unafraid to stand for the people. She first saw the connections between Black and Palestinian struggles against state violence in 2014, when she met with a Palestinian delegation who visited Ferguson Uprising activists to share tips on how to defend themselves from militarized violence and tear gas. During the protests, Palestinians in St. Louis also showed up in support of Black lives, and conversations about their oppression opened her eyes as together they fought for collective liberation. While in Congress, Cori has advocated for marginalized and oppressed people in the U.S. and abroad. She has championed Palestinian rights, including by leading her colleagues to push the U.S. State Department to stop Israel’s forced displacement of hundreds of Palestinian children. In the past month, Cori made the principled decision to boycott congressional speeches from Israel’s President and India’s Prime Minister for perpetuating human rights abuses. Cori continues to be one of the few members of Congress to legislate with love for all humanity, without exceptions. That’s why she challenges the status quo, and it’s why the right-wing continues to target her. subject: Pekau's Projection: Putting Aside Partisanship
body:
As Mayor Pekau lays groundwork for another congressional run, he puts forth a kindler, gentler message, in stark contrast to his seven-year tenure.

View this email in your browser (https://mailchi.mp/7c6d966fa434/pekaus-projection-putting-aside-partisanship?e=1cb5fdae9e)
https://www.illinoisreview.com/?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=9bb967d0ab-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_07_28_06_37&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-9bb967d0ab-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D
Illinois Review eBlast Powered By
https://kasparlaw.co/?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=9bb967d0ab-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_07_28_06_37&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-9bb967d0ab-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D
https://www.bestdental.org/?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=9bb967d0ab-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_07_28_06_37&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-9bb967d0ab-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D

Mayor Keith Pekau Pretends to Be a Fiscal Conservative and Unifying Politician in DC OpEd, as He Prepares to Run for Congress, But Mayoral Record Tells a Different Story (https://www.illinoisreview.com/illinoisreview/2023/07/mayor-keith-pekau-pretends-to-be-a-fiscal-conservative-and-unifying-politician-in-dc-oped-as-he-prepares-to-run-for-congress-but-mayoral-record-tells-a-different-story.html?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=9bb967d0ab-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_07_28_06_37&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-9bb967d0ab-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D)
https://www.illinoisreview.com/illinoisreview/2023/07/mayor-keith-pekau-pretends-to-be-a-fiscal-conservative-and-unifying-politician-in-dc-oped-as-he-prepares-to-run-for-congress-but-mayoral-record-tells-a-different-story.html?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=9bb967d0ab-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_07_28_06_37&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-9bb967d0ab-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D
Keith Pekau turning in his petitions at the State Board of Elections during his failed congressional campaign. (Source: Daily Herald)
In an opinion piece published this week in the Washington Examiner (https://www.washingtonexaminer.com/restoring-america/courage-strength-optimism/the-us-debt-problem-is-not-insurmountable?fbclid=IwAR1zTRZIaeA74YCIWRTV_p0CDLWSaC56R8X65Wi79S8h00tURjzL74qNtuQ_aem_AaE3J0UyafPCkSRDYygGyGXnj0mcFel_8vmMHGibEmVt24r76NrGGEDs80L-YerAGQY&mibextid=Zxz2cZ&utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=9bb967d0ab-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_07_28_06_37&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-9bb967d0ab-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D) , Orland Park Mayor Keith Pekau – who is laying the groundwork to launch another congressional campaign, addressed the US deficit – arguing that we must “put aside partisan bickering” if there’s any hope of solving our country’s financial crisis.

But back home, Pekau’s tenure as mayor of Orland Park tells a different story.

In June, Pekau created a new
utility tax (https://patch.com/illinois/orlandpark/orland-imposes-new-utility-tax-raises-sales-tax?utm_term=article-slot-1&utm_source=newsletter-daily&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=newsletter&utm_content=email-test_E1:v1&user_email=a7d811a4a2701ec43d310edcd78a40c94541f75ebbc2b3298de7572df95983c0&utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=9bb967d0ab-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_07_28_06_37&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-9bb967d0ab-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D) – meaning constituents will have to pay more for gas and electricity in the midst of recession fears.

And that’s not all.

Pekau has also recently implemented a wildly unpopular new sales tax that surpasses Democratic-controlled Chicago’s sales tax, to help pay for a variety of his initiatives, including a
$10 million (https://patch.com/illinois/orlandpark/orland-imposes-new-utility-tax-raises-sales-tax?utm_term=article-slot-1&utm_source=newsletter-daily&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=newsletter&utm_content=email-test_E1:v1&user_email=a7d811a4a2701ec43d310edcd78a40c94541f75ebbc2b3298de7572df95983c0&utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=9bb967d0ab-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_07_28_06_37&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-9bb967d0ab-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D) concert stage at Centennial Park West.

Reports suggest that the price tag for the concert stage is closer to $16 million – but Pekau continues to claim that it won’t cost any more than $10 million to $12 million to build.

However, if the attendance at free concerts is any indication of the lack of interest and support – the idea of building a multi-million dollar concert venue where residents will have to pay for shows – seems like a concept that will be dead on arrival and a total waste of taxpayer money.

During a recent Village of Orland Park Board of Trustee meeting, Mayor Pekau
bragged (https://www.illinoisreview.com/illinoisreview/2023/07/mayor-keith-pekau-brags-about-large-crowd-size-of-2500-during-orland-parks-free-concert-last-weekend-but-actual-photos-reveal-less-than-50-in-attendance.html?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=9bb967d0ab-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_07_28_06_37&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-9bb967d0ab-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D) about the attendance at the last free concert in the park – claiming there were “2,500 people at the last one” – but as photos from concertgoers revealed, there were less than 50 in attendance.

Meaning Pekau’s estimates were off by about 2,450.
https://www.illinoisreview.com/illinoisreview/2023/07/mayor-keith-pekau-pretends-to-be-a-fiscal-conservative-and-unifying-politician-in-dc-oped-as-he-prepares-to-run-for-congress-but-mayoral-record-tells-a-different-story.html?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=9bb967d0ab-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_07_28_06_37&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-9bb967d0ab-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D
Less than 50 people attended the free concert in Orland Park last weekend, despite Mayor Keith Pekau claiming that were were “2,500 people” in attendance.
In his opinion piece, Pekau also talks about the need to set aside “partisan bickering” – and he calls on the public “to support and elect people willing to roll up their sleeves, put partisanship aside, and work toward these commonsense solutions.”

But back home, Pekau remains one of the most divisive mayors in recent history – and he’s known for attacking and harassing constituents online, in his official mayoral emails and during meetings and speeches.

In 2021, Pekau and his slate of hand-picked candidates campaigned on “
putting people over politics (https://keithpekau.com/pop/?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=9bb967d0ab-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_07_28_06_37&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-9bb967d0ab-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D) ” and being a voice for everyone, regardless of political parties and affiliations.

However, what the residents have witnessed instead, is a mayor obsessed with power and control.

Residents have also witnessed a mayor who frequently exhibits abusive behavior towards the very people who elected him.

Question his motives or point out his hypocrisy and he publicly labels you a liar.

Pekau also governs by fear, and like a
dictator (https://www.illinoisreview.com/illinoisreview/2023/03/sources-paranoid-pekau-installs-bulletproof-glass-frosts-windows-in-orland-park-village-board-room-making-case-for-security-detail-if-referendum-passes.html?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=9bb967d0ab-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_07_28_06_37&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-9bb967d0ab-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D) , he’s always looking for sympathy – manipulating the narrative and changing the script so that he’s always the victim – in every situation.

He’s also a bully and rude, and he frequently attacks women in public comments online – and then deleting those comments, only after they’ve been read by the intended recipient as a form of intimidation.

In late March, Pekau and his close friend and fellow trustee Sean Kampas were caught harassing female
Orland Fire Protection District (https://www.illinoisreview.com/illinoisreview/2023/03/witnesses-keith-pekau-harasses-intimidates-female-orland-fire-dist-candidates-follows-them-in-his-car-while-they-knocked-on-doors.html?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=9bb967d0ab-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_07_28_06_37&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-9bb967d0ab-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D) candidates Angela Greenfield and Tina Zekich and their volunteers as they campaigned and knocked on doors in a local neighborhood just a week before the April elections.

Pekau and Kampas spent the morning following the group in Pekau’s Dodge Durango as they walked a nearby neighborhood to knock on doors and drop off literature.

Although Pekau and Kampas never got out of the car, numerous witnesses said the pair continued to follow the group as they knocked on doors – staring at them through the car windows in a sad attempt at intimidating the group of volunteers who were campaigning on behalf of candidates that they opposed.
https://www.illinoisreview.com/illinoisreview/2023/07/mayor-keith-pekau-pretends-to-be-a-fiscal-conservative-and-unifying-politician-in-dc-oped-as-he-prepares-to-run-for-congress-but-mayoral-record-tells-a-different-story.html?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=9bb967d0ab-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_07_28_06_37&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-9bb967d0ab-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D
Orland Park Mayor Keith Pekau, left, and Orland Park Trustee Sean Kampas, right, at a local Starbucks to harass and intimidate candidates running against Pekau’s slate for Orland Fire Protection District.
Nevertheless, the embattled mayor remains incredibly unpopular, and the last several events he’s hosted around town have drawn extremely small crowds.

In March, Pekau hosted a
town hall meeting (https://www.illinoisreview.com/illinoisreview/2023/03/mayor-keith-pekau-attacks-insults-constituents-online-proving-hes-a-better-fit-as-a-server-at-ed-debevics-than-mayor-of-orland-park.html?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=9bb967d0ab-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_07_28_06_37&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-9bb967d0ab-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D) to discuss his referendum to expand his power and influence on all village matters, with an estimated 15 people in attendance despite the room being set up for 100.
https://www.illinoisreview.com/illinoisreview/2023/07/mayor-keith-pekau-pretends-to-be-a-fiscal-conservative-and-unifying-politician-in-dc-oped-as-he-prepares-to-run-for-congress-but-mayoral-record-tells-a-different-story.html?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=9bb967d0ab-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_07_28_06_37&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-9bb967d0ab-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D
Orland Park Mayor Keith Pekau, top right, walking to the front to address a nearly-empty room at the Orland Park Public Library on March 22, 2023. (Source: Illinois Review)
A few weeks later, Pekau would suffer humiliating defeats (https://www.illinoisreview.com/illinoisreview/2023/04/orland-park-voters-reject-keith-pekaus-power-grab-delivering-the-mayor-humiliating-defeats-in-election-night-disaster.html?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=9bb967d0ab-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_07_28_06_37&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-9bb967d0ab-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D) during the April election as residents resoundingly rejected his power grab dubbed as a “referendum” by a shocking 31 points.

But that wasn’t all. Voters also rejected Pekau’s slate of endorsed candidates, losing 9 out of 10 races – proving that an overwhelming majority of Orland Park residents rejected Pekau and anyone associated with the power-hungry and divisive mayor.

And while Pekau continues to attract incredibly small crowds, with his divisive and abusive behavior on full display, he continues to lay the groundwork to launch yet another congressional campaign.

And now he’s publishing opinion pieces in Washington publications.

While Pekau lacks the temperament to serve in elected office, he has proven, however, to be a better fit as a
waiter (https://www.illinoisreview.com/illinoisreview/2023/03/mayor-keith-pekau-attacks-insults-constituents-online-proving-hes-a-better-fit-as-a-server-at-ed-debevics-than-mayor-of-orland-park.html?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=9bb967d0ab-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_07_28_06_37&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-9bb967d0ab-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D) at Ed Debevic’s, where being rude and a bully is part of the charm.

Perhaps it’s time for Pekau to think about a career change. And we’re not talking about Congress.

subject: The Brief #58
body:
Three things to know.
---
| | | | | | | |
---
| | | | |
---
| _Welcome to The Brief!: Common sense takes on current events, national security, and technology and the latest campaign info. It’s designed to make you smarter in less than 5 minutes! If you were forwarded this message, you can get_[ _The Brief here_](https://75y20.r.a.d.sendibm1.com/mk/cl/f/sh/SMK18yw1bMnwlgRIq48brepah1LI/IBfG6XD4uMIe) _._
---
| Dear Friends,
Thanks for all the support as we enter the second month of the campaign. One of the campaign stops I made last week was at Dartmouth College in Hanover, New Hampshire where I unveiled a plan on how to harness Artificial Intelligence.
Other campaigns had a rough week. For instance, Florida Governor Ron DeSantis is seeing his numbers plummet. One reason, his failure to understand slavery.
Inhumanity at the border was in the news. As long as Joe Biden is President, border security will stay in the news because he is so bad at it. However, we need to be outraged by all the inhumane actions happening at our border.
Here are 3 perspectives that haven’t gotten proper attention since we last talked.
---
| | [](https://75y20.r.a.d.sendibm1.com/mk/cl/f/sh/SMK18yw1bp8ey6pevzIrvUDPfl3M/LV7NalBcrlSf)
---
---
| | | | |
### 1\. A TUTOR IN YOUR POCKET
---

| [ ](https://75y20.r.a.d.sendibm1.com/mk/cl/f/sh/SMK18yw1cHTNAXE11uT7zJbEeUlQ/5z72GKHpX3VC)
---
| **Big Picture:** Eighty-five million jobs worldwide could be threatened by AI. **Why This Matters:** Like any tool, it can be used for good or evil. **Solutions:** AI can create millions of new jobs rather than unemployment, and we have income inequality because we have education inequality. Here's one way to solve this problem:
* A national program that gives every student an AI tutor.

**Bottom-line:** Imagine every child or worker, who needs one, gets to have a tutor in their pocket whether he or she is learning coding, farming or plumbing.
* Instead of getting rid of the Department of Education, why not have it work for our future. Watch clips from my speech at Dartmouth to learn more about [how we take advantage of technology before it takes advantage of us.](https://75y20.r.a.d.sendibm1.com/mk/cl/f/sh/SMK18yw1cjo5MxcN7pdO38z3dETU/HtQjCAL17648)

---

| | | | |
### 2\. SLAVERY WASN’T A JOBS PROGRAM
---

|
---
| **Big Picture:** The Florida Department of Education (DOE) provided an [update to its standards for teaching African-American studies ](https://75y20.r.a.d.sendibm1.com/mk/cl/f/sh/SMK18yw1dC8nZO0jDkne6yMsbyBY/Js6Qh4WpeoXf)that was met with resistance because of how they planned to teach about slavery.
**The State of Play:** Florida issued a benchmark clarification explaining that when it came to slavery, Florida would have "Instruction including how slaves developed skills which, in some instances, could be applied for their personal benefit."

* In response to press inquiries about this matter, the Florida DOE doubled down: "The intent of this particular benchmark clarification is to show that some slaves developed highly specialized trades from which they benefited."

**Go Deeper:** Both of these statements imply that there was an upside to slavery. Slavery wasn't a jobs program that taught beneficial skills. it was literally dehumanizing and subjugating people as property because they lacked any rights or freedoms.
* This isn’t about Critical Race Theory. This isn’t about being Woke or Anti-Woke. This is about teaching our kids that there were absolutely no positive aspects of slavery.

**Why This Matters:** If the goal was to highlight how black history is more than tragedy, sadness and brutality, then that is great. If they want to talk about the insurmountable odds our ancestors overcame to make an impact on our country, then great. But the above statements from the Florida educational entities fail to reflect that sentiment.
* Failures of leadership like this by Governor Ron Desantis tarnish the Republican brand and prevent the GOP from growing in black and brown communities. This is one of the reasons Republicans haven't won a national popular election in 20 years.

**Bottom-line:** If you want perspectives like this on the Republican Presidential debate stage, help me get 40,000 individual donors by Aug 23. The maximum a person can give me for the entire primary campaign is $3,300, but any amount matters.
* [Click here](https://75y20.r.a.d.sendibm1.com/mk/cl/f/sh/SMK18yw1deTVloP5JfxuAnkhahtc/DZyfADbWH2qr) to help us talk to more people and qualify for the debate stage. Even donating $1 helps!

---

| | | | |
### 3\. INHUMANITY AT THE BORDER
---

|
---
| Photo: State law enforcement officers stand guard as workers deploy a string of buoys to prevent migrants from swimming across the Rio Grande in Eagle Pass on July 14 - Jordan Vonderhaar, The Texas Tribune.
**What Happened:** An email from a Texas Department of Public Safety (DPS) trooper alleges [inhumane treatment of migrants,](https://75y20.r.a.d.sendibm1.com/mk/cl/f/sh/SMK18yw1e6oDyEnRPb8AEd8WZRbg/Ctii1uMPyyiS) including orders to push children back into the Rio Grande and withhold water from asylum seekers.
* Amid escalating tensions over the state's aggressive border security measures, the state's DPS denies these allegations while calling for an audit.

**Go Deeper:** I cannot imagine a Texas law enforcement official giving such an order, but if someone did, then heads need to roll over the alleged inhumanity.
* We should also be outraged by the people that have caused most of the deaths and injuries of migrants over the last few years – the cartels and human smugglers who are lying to migrants and illegally pushing them across our border in between our ports of entry.

**Bottom-line:** Joe Biden's inability to control the border has caused this humanitarian crisis. This has gone on for too long under Biden and Trump. America needs a border reset. We can secure the border, treat migrants humanely, and put an end to this humanitarian crisis. Here’s how:
* Appoint a DHS Secretary who knows border security.
* Meet with border governors, sheriffs, county judges, and mayors. Listen to their needs and collaborate on solutions to fix the crisis in each community.
* Pressure the President of Mexico for cooperation and meaningful action to help us dismantle cartels and human smugglers.
* Achieve operational control of the border with technology that already exists and more manpower.
* Enlist other countries to establish welcome centers and handle the deportation of their citizens more efficiently.

---

Thank you! God bless America and don’t forget to [donate today!](https://75y20.r.a.d.sendibm1.com/mk/cl/f/sh/SMK18yw1eZ8wAfBnVWIQISWLYBJk/vy-sNCme9fk7) Will Hurd

| | On our first fundraising report last month, we blew everyone away with the grassroots supporters who rallied around Mark’s campaign.

Defeating a deeply entrenched GOP incumbent in a tough red district is no easy task. Truthfully, there weren't many people who thought she could pull it off. **But on election night in 2006, people everywhere learned to never — _ever_ — count Kirsten out.** (For the record, I'm proud to be one of her earliest believers.)
Since that first election, Kirsten has proven herself time and time as a fierce, bold advocate for families around America. The minute she was sworn in as our junior senator, I gained an incredible partner. During our time serving in the Senate, we've worked together on countless pieces of legislation, secured millions in federal funding for vital social programs and proudly fought for progress as a united team.
**As Kirsten's colleague and friend —** _and as our Senate majority_** **_leader_**— take it from me: We need Kirsten's voice in the Senate.** But following a red wave in New York last year, Republicans are already targeting her seat for defeat.

body:
| | | | | [](https://us.engagingnetworks.app/page/email/click/10012/1902236?email=RepJ2ZGQKX6xm5Aey7FwClESkN1MQhKC&campid=UI6tX83ZqbKZkArzVWMSmA==)
---|---|---

| | **URGENT: Help protect the two new baby Southern Resident orcas from starvation resulting from corporate overfishing and bycatch!** [**Take action now! >>**](https://us.engagingnetworks.app/page/email/click/10012/1902237?email=RepJ2ZGQKX6xm5Aey7FwClESkN1MQhKC&campid=UI6tX83ZqbKZkArzVWMSmA==) **69% of orca pregnancies end in miscarriage, Friend.** And with the endangered Southern Resident orca population at its lowest since the 1970’s, it’s critical that we restore this dwindling species before we lose these iconic whales forever. That’s why it’s such wonderful news that __**TWO baby orcas**__ have just been confirmed! Born into the very same pod as the beloved matriarch Marina who died just a few short years ago, these new whale calves could play an important role in recovering this dying species. But we don’t want to get too ahead of ourselves, Friend. Sadly, the mortality rate for newborns is as **high as 50%** , so these baby orcas won’t even be counted and named until they can survive _at least a year_ after birth. If these two newborn orcas are going to have a chance at survival, it’s imperative that they have enough food to keep them nourished and growing strong. But corporate overfishing and bycatch has been **DECIMATING** Chinook salmon populations, leaving many orcas starving and malnourished. These two newborn orcas are counting on us to be their voice so that they can grow up to live healthy and happy lives. [**Will you add your name NOW to tell the National Marine Fisheries Service to rein in greedy fishing corporations from taking away orcas’ food supply?**](https://us.engagingnetworks.app/page/email/click/10012/1902238?email=RepJ2ZGQKX6xm5Aey7FwClESkN1MQhKC&campid=UI6tX83ZqbKZkArzVWMSmA==) | [SIGN THE PETITION](https://us.engagingnetworks.app/page/email/click/10012/1902239?email=RepJ2ZGQKX6xm5Aey7FwClESkN1MQhKC&campid=UI6tX83ZqbKZkArzVWMSmA==)
---
With the losses of Marina, Cappuccino, and Ripple over the last couple of years alone, Southern Resident killer whales have been clinging to survival and suffering from **stress, grief, miscarriage, and starvation.** When even just one member of their tight-knit pod dies, these sensitive animals can feel the _**heavy sadness**_ of losing a family member.
The births of the two new orcas is a hopeful sign of recovery for these treasured mammals, **but the odds are still stacked against them. **
Threats like global warming, ocean acidification, and increased water pollution _have all been largely driven by humans_ — so if we’re going to _**SAVE the last of these precious marine animals**_ , the least that we can do now is take the necessary steps to mitigate further dangers and help replenish their food supply before they go **EXTINCT.**
That’s why we’re calling on environmentalists like you to step up and do the right thing for these endangered orcas, Friend. We need to collect _**3,702**_ more signatures **by 11:59 P.M. TONIGHT** to pressure NMFS to address rampant overfishing and bycatch before the last 75 Southern Resident orcas are _**WIPED OUT FOREVER.**_ [**Please help protect these endangered orcas and their precious two newborn calves before they go _EXTINCT_. Sign the petition right away! >>**](https://us.engagingnetworks.app/page/email/click/10012/1902240?email=RepJ2ZGQKX6xm5Aey7FwClESkN1MQhKC&campid=UI6tX83ZqbKZkArzVWMSmA==)
[SIGN THE PETITION](https://us.engagingnetworks.app/page/email/click/10012/1902239?email=RepJ2ZGQKX6xm5Aey7FwClESkN1MQhKC&campid=UI6tX83ZqbKZkArzVWMSmA==)
---
**Thanks for your urgent action to protect endangered orcas!**
**Standing with you,
Marcie Keever
Oceans and Vessels Program Director,
Friends of the Earth**

Hi friend –
You may have seen on the news that a Senator from Alabama is currently blocking hundreds of military promotions.
Michael has been fighting this pointless obstruction from the start, and we wanted to take a minute and give you more of the story.
In February, Senator Tuberville, a Republican from Alabama, took the unprecedented step of blocking all military nominations. No member of Congress in American history has ever done this — and Michael was the first Senator to point this out on the Senate floor.
Months later, Tuberville is still blocking our service members from their well-earned promotions — claiming it's in protest of a Department of Defense policy that protects access to reproductive care for women in uniform.
This political game is jeopardizing our national security. His obstruction could prevent as many as 650 nominations, and is stopping the Senate from filling vacancies as high up as the Chairman of the Joint Chiefs of Staff and the Commandant of the Marine Corps.
These are people who have dedicated their lives to this country — and they deserve nothing less than the best from their nation’s leaders.
To make matters worse, Senator Tuberville is doing this to make women's lives more difficult as they face an intensely personal choice.
He wants to force women in the military to pay their own travel out of state for an abortion, and use their days off to do so.
He wants to make our service members' lives harder, and he must be stopped.
Michael was the first person calling on Senator Tuberville to end this charade. He's been more vocal about it than anyone else — and he won’t stop until this ends.
We created a petition to call on the Senate to protect the reproductive rights of our servicemembers. Will you join us by signing your name? [https://secure.michaelbennet.com/a/x_072623_dodreprorights]

Sending you this message gives me no pleasure, friend, I’m not excited to tell you that our country is being run into the ground by coastal elites like Joe Biden and Chuck Schumer.
I’m not excited to put yet another political message in your inbox. But if I’m going to make it to Washington and defeat an establishment Democrat who is nothing but a rubber stamp for Joe Biden, then I have to do everything in my power to rally patriotic Americans across the country to win! My name is Sam Brown. That’s me in the pictures.
---
[](https://americanvictory2024.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0631e376515e4dcd945c8fba9&id=40b339ff31&e=84ee529f47)

| Meet **Mark Walker**

Congressman Mark Walker started his career in finance and, after earning his theology degree, Walker served 16 years as a pastor. In 2014, Walker stepped away from ministry and made a successful run for the U.S. Congress defeating a host of elected politicians. In 2015, Congressman Walker became the first member in an inaugural term to be elected Chair of the Republican Study Committee (RSC) - the largest caucus in Congress with 160 members and a position previously held by Vice President Pence and Congressman Jim Jordan.

In 2018, Walker was elected as Vice Chair of the entire conference, becoming the highest rated conservative to serve in the top four leadership positions in Congress. Walker is also the last member of Congress to secure a floor vote on a balanced budget amendment and led the House on HBCU initiatives winning the United Negro College Fund President’s list award. Congressman Walker served on multiple committees and in 2019, Walker was appointed to ranking member on the Committee on Homeland Security’s Intelligence and Counter-Terrorism’s subcommittee. Walker was co-chair of the bicameral prayer caucus for five years and also won the GOP MVP award as the starting pitcher on the Republican baseball team for the annual charity game.

Congressman Walker was redistricted out of his seat and stepped away from Congress in 2021. Walker ran for U.S. Senate in 2022 and was endorsed by Senators Tim Scott and James Lankford, Gov. Mike Huckabee, Hall of Fame Coach Tony Dungy and more than 200 pastors across North Carolina. Walker is currently the president of a political consulting business called Advancing Hope USA, and advocated for the two North Carolina Supreme Court candidates and 4 North Carolina Court of Appeals candidates through his independent expenditure organization, Win the Courts during this past general election. Congressman Walker and his wife Kelly, a Family Nurse Practitioner and flight trauma specialist, have been married for thirty years and have three children.

Mike Huckabee, Hall of Fame Coach Tony Dungy and more than 200 pastors across North Carolina. name: JusticeDemocrats.com
subject: Do you remember November 13th, 2018?
body:
#
Peter, do you remember November 13th, 2018?
That’s the day when Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez joined Sunrise Movement and Justice Democrats in a sit-in protest in Nancy Pelosi’s office to stand against inaction from the political establishment in addressing the climate crisis.
The 2018 IPCC Report had shown that we only have until 2030 to take significant climate change action before we reach irreversible damage. That’s why AOC joined a sit-in with Sunrise Movement and us as a newly elected member of Congress who took on the machine and won.
We were there with her during the sit-in because we were committed to showing what it meant to use the power you have as a federally elected leader to transform the conversation. Electoral politics means nothing without a sustained social movement ready to build, demonstrate, and wield real power to hold our elected officials accountable for governing.
Today, the impact of the climate crisis is even more readily apparent. It’s even more urgent that we pass and implement a Green New Deal to save the planet before it’s too late.
[**If Democrats aren’t ready to listen to the demands of young, diverse, and progressive voters who are energizing the Democratic Party, then it’s time for them to get out of the way. Help us continue pushing for a Green New Deal in 2023 with a $3 contribution today.**](https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/136177?refcode=em20230728-30112&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1&akid=30112%2E1203867%2ESvl_Xu)
**[Donate $3](https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/136177?refcode=em20230728-30112&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=20&akid=30112%2E1203867%2ESvl_Xu)**
Working-class, grassroots leadership means that when you enter the halls of power, you bring the people with you. Alexandria showed what JD leadership can look like on the inside. Now we have to work to elect another slate of JD candidates to serve with her and the entire JD bloc in Congress.
Our communities deserve better. We cannot continue to accept the status quo.
Thank you for being in this fight with us.
In solidarity,
Justice Democrats
Do not worry if you cannot afford to make a contribution — we understand that this is a difficult time. If you’re struggling, you can find a food bank [here.](https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/28883?t=21&akid=30112%2E1203867%2ESvl_Xu) We appreciate everything you do to keep our movement strong. Please stay informed and follow the most up-to-date recommendations from the [Centers for Disease Control](https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/24438?t=22&akid=30112%2E1203867%2ESvl_Xu) and your state public health department.
---

name: Flo Rossmiller
subject: Will you host an event for Joe Kent?
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Joe Kent for Congress
body:
Dear Peter,

I have a unique request for you: would you be willing to host an event for Joe Kent?

If you live in Washington's 3rd District:

We're looking for supporters who can invite their friends, family, and neighbors to a "Meet & Greet." These are typically held at the host's home but can also take place at an office, a nearby park, or other facility. It's a great way to introduce Joe to people you know so he can share his message and ask for their votes.

If you live outside Washington's 3rd District:

Because this is such an important election and Joe is such a compelling candidate, people around the US have rallied to help him overcome the financial advantage Democrat Marie Perez has, thanks to special interest PAC money flooding into her campaign's bank accounts. Let me know if you can host a fundraising event for Joe.

Please email me back if you're able to help.

Thank you!

Flo Rossmiller
Director of Outreach and Coalitions
Joe Kent for Congress

Paid for by Joe Kent for Congress

body:
Being polite is not the same thing as being quiet.
#
We talk a lot about fighting for ‘justice.’
Justice is not a concept we read about in a book. Justice is about the water we drink, the air we breathe, how easy it is to vote.
Justice is about if we can stay with our children after we have them for a just amount of time — mothers, fathers, and all parents.
Justice is about making sure that **being polite is not the same thing as being quiet.**
In fact, oftentimes the most just thing you can do is shake the table.
**[If you’re ready to say that in the United States, everyone is loved, everyone deserves justice, and everyone deserves equal protection and prosperity — will you make a $5 contribution to our campaign for progress today?](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20230728.xCDKQh&refcode=em20230728-4713-P_FND_EGR_GOL&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1&akid=4713%2E2526796%2EFJshZ3)**

clean_body: Being polite is not the same thing as being quiet. We talk a lot about fighting for ‘justice.’ Justice is not a concept we read about in a book. Justice is about the water we drink, the air we breathe, how easy it is to vote. Justice is about if we can stay with our children after we have them for a just amount of time — mothers, fathers, and all parents. Justice is about making sure that being polite is not the same thing as being quiet. In fact, oftentimes the most just thing you can do is shake the table. | Although he’s no longer president, the iron grip that Donald Trump holds on the Republican Party is as tight as ever. Especially as he’s poised to become their nominee.
# [](https://act.adamschiff.com/go/61?t=1&akid=3163%2E5257348%2E0iMSuk)
Derek, in a moment, **[I’m going to ask you to chip in to my campaign for the U.S. Senate.](https://act.adamschiff.com/go/1014?c0=july2023_abs_em.rnu5kc&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_GEN_EGR_AC90_20230728_PM1_V1_S1&email=&t=4&akid=3163%2E5257348%2E0iMSuk)** But first, I want to explain why Donald Trump and his MAGA cronies are so hell-bent on keeping me out of the U.S. Senate.
Although he’s no longer president, the iron grip that Donald Trump holds on the Republican Party is as tight as ever. Especially as he’s poised to become their nominee.
Most elected Republicans, whether or not they personally support him, are obliged to follow his every order and defend him with all their might — because to disobey him is to end your political career.
It’s the reason why every Republican member of Congress who voted against censuring me the first time around changed their votes — **_because Donald Trump pledged to primary them if they didn’t vote the way he wanted._**
It’s why Kevin McCarthy may have made a backroom deal to expunge Trump’s impeachments — **_because losing Trump’s support means losing his speakership to some other right-wing crazy._**
It’s why nearly every GOP presidential candidate refuses to speak out against Trump’s indictments and lies — **_because they know he will ruthlessly retaliate to maintain his control over the Republican Party._**
Derek, while so many have refused to stand up to Donald Trump, I have never cowered to the whims of the twice-impeached ex-president. **And that’s why he’s so upset with the idea that Californians may elect me to the Senate.**
Trump, McCarthy, and their MAGA cronies are throwing every possible attack at me.
They’ve removed me from the House Intelligence Committee, they’ve censured me, they’ve smeared me on _Fox News._
They’ve introduced legislation to bar me from receiving classified information, poured resources into a dark money group called STOP ADAM PAC, threatened to fine me $16 million and even to expel me from Congress.
Their relentless efforts to defeat me won’t deter me from my work to hold them accountable.
But as they spend more money to try to hold our campaign back, we need to build up our defenses.
**[That’s where you come in — Derek, could you chip in to my Senate campaign so we can stay strong against these attacks and continue to hold Trump and McCarthy accountable?](https://act.adamschiff.com/go/1312?c0=july2023_abs_em.luhYnl&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_GEN_EGR_AC90_20230728_PM1_V1_S1&email=&t=5&akid=3163%2E5257348%2E0iMSuk)**

| A native Floridian with blue-collar roots, Ron was raised in Dunedin by his mother, a nurse, and father, who installed cable boxes. He attended Dunedin High School and worked his way through Yale University, where he was the captain of the varsity baseball team. He also graduated with honors from Harvard Law School, where he earned a commission in the U.S. Navy as a JAG officer.

During his active-duty service, Ron deployed to Iraq in support of the SEAL mission in Fallujah, Ramadi and the rest of Al Anbar province. His military decorations include the Bronze Star Medal for Meritorious Service and the Iraq Campaign Medal.
---
Ron also served as a prosecutor in Florida, where he put child predators behind bars. He was elected to Congress in 2012 on a platform of government accountability, advocating for term limits and a balanced budget amendment.

In Congress, DeSantis spearheaded the fight to expose the weaponization of the IRS against conservatives. He also fought to hold accountable the rogue federal agencies involved in manufacturing the "Russia collusion" conspiracy theory. As a veteran, DeSantis was a champion for those who have served our country, pushing for reforms to the VA to better serve veterans and expand support for mental health.

In 2018, Ron DeSantis was elected the 46th Governor of Florida. As governor, he has fought for what's right and taken the arrows for the people he represents. During the darkest days of 2020, when the corrupt establishment, bureaucracy, and corporate media united to force lockdowns and mandates on Americans, DeSantis stood up for freedom - even when it wasn't popular.

Grounded in his unshakeable belief in America's founding principles, Governor DeSantis has enacted a bold agenda to transform Florida into a blueprint for the Nation's revival. Governor DeSantis has delivered win after win on conservative priorities:
* Saving livelihoods from job-killing lockdowns and vaccine mandates,

* Protecting citizens from the harmful impacts of Biden's border crisis by enacting E-Verify and other bold policies against illegal immigration, such as banning sanctuary cities,

* Defending parental rights and eliminating CRT,

* Defunding DEI bureaucracy in higher ed and holding tenured professors accountable,

* Waging war on woke power-grabs like ESG and central bank digital currency,

* Enacting the strongest medical freedom laws in the nation,

* Turning Florida into a model for election integrity,

* Protecting the unborn,

* Standing up for the 2nd Amendment by making Florida a constitutional carry state,

* Expanding education freedom,

* Prohibiting land purchases by the CCP and related individuals and entities,

* Lowering prescription drug costs,

* Holding woke corporations and school unions accountable,

* Creating a universal school choice program,

* Delivering record-breaking tax relief,

* Helping families achieve the American dream of homeownership,

* Supporting law enforcement and our veterans,

* Enacting tougher penalties for drug dealers and sex offenders,

* Appointing seven conservative justices to the Florida Supreme Court,

* ...and so much more.

After leading Florida with common sense and conviction throughout his first term, DeSantis delivered a record-setting victory of nearly 20 points in 2022. He earned his second term by the largest raw vote margin in state history, winning by more than 1.5 million votes.

But history didn't stop there:

Governor DeSantis flipped Miami-Dade County red, winning the majority-Hispanic urban county by double digits. Conventional wisdom assumed this was impossible for a Republican - as recently as 2016, Hillary Clinton won Miami-Dade County by nearly 30 points.

Governor DeSantis flipped several other blue counties red, including Palm Beach County. He won 62 out of 67 counties overall.

Compared to his first statewide election in 2018, Governor DeSantis was up +19% with Independents, up +30% with Hispanics, and up +9% with women.

Governor DeSantis delivered a record-setting victory with battle-tested leadership, a bold policy agenda, and never backing down to corporate media or special interests. As he said at his inauguration: "When the world lost its mind - when common sense suddenly became an uncommon virtue - Florida was a refuge of sanity, a citadel of freedom for our fellow Americans and even for people around the world. In captaining the ship of state, we choose to navigate the boisterous sea of liberty rather than cower in the calm docks of despotism."

Governor DeSantis has ensured that Florida is a free and safe place to raise a family. Thanks to the governor's leadership, Floridians enjoy a low tax burden, quality education opportunities, and a bulwark in place against the Biden Administration's overreach and various elite power grabs that seek to force people to adopt a particular ideology. Thanks to the governor's vision, this year's legislative session delivered the most ambitious conservative policy victories in Florida's history.

This year, Governor DeSantis signed:
* Record tax relief

* ESG prohibitions

* Measures counteracting the influence of the CCP

* The strongest medical freedom protections in the nation.

* Reforms reducing the costs of medications by delivering transparency

* Bold higher education reforms; defunding DEI

* Improvements to our state's infrastructure

* Tough-on-crime, law and order measures, including the death penalty for child rapists

* The strongest measures protecting Florida from Biden's border crisis

* Reforms for paycheck protection , holding accountable wayward school unions

* Prohibitions on centralized digital currencies in Florida

No leader has accomplished more for his state than Governor DeSantis. He is now sharing his bold vision with the country, leading a movement to deliver the Great American Comeback.

Ron is married to Casey DeSantis, an Emmy Award- winning television anchor. Together, they're the proud parents of their daughters, Madison and Mamie, and their son, Mason.

2024 will be here before we know it (really, just 157 days away!), and we need to build up our defenses now. |
#
We really mean it, team: **Next year’s elections are some of the most important in our lifetime.** So much is at stake — control of the White House, the Senate, and the House of Representatives is on the line, and maintaining or gaining Democratic majorities is critical to stopping the worst of MAGA Republicans’ extreme, far-right agenda. **It’s going to be a long fight to get ahead of the GOP’s misleading attacks — already, Republican groups are going after Tina’s colleagues in the Senate up for reelection in competitive states like Wisconsin, Ohio, and Montana.** Not to mention the bad-faith attacks on President Biden. Donald Trump, Ron DeSantis, and Republicans in Congress are smearing the President’s record and lying about the incredible progress he’s made for the American people over the last few years. **That’s why Tina is hard at work as the Vice Chair of the Senate Dems campaign arm, defending Democrats’ successes and getting ahead of Republican lies.** 2024 will be here before we know it (really, just 157 days away!), and we need to build up our defenses now. Fellow Patriot, By now, you’ve probably heard that I’m running for U.S. Senate.

But I wanted to take just two minutes to tell you my story and explain why I’ve joined this fight.

I was born in Communist Vietnam during the war. My father bravely spoke out against the Communist Party - and he was put on a kill list for it.

**We were fortunate to legally immigrate to the United States, where we found freedom and a new life.**

_If it wasn’t for America’s freedom and generosity, I might not be alive right now._
I came to this country not speaking a word of English. But in just fourteen years, I was appointed to the United States Naval Academy to prepare for a career defending America.

I went on to become a Captain in the Navy and I served for 25 years in special operations diffusing explosives and performing deep sea dives. I saw some of the most dangerous corners of the world, from Afghanistan to Somalia.

_But all the sacrifices and hard work was worth it, because I knew I was giving back to the country that gave me everything._
---
[](http://links.right-gop.com/u/click?_t=2ba4f933732b46f5b6eae32741d1832c&_m=4418357ae95743b9bc3da168704b78be&_e=kVjiUPGq5_UZwXZg4f8hM8EqG7AFVySovtJQc0W_zfmzDqp2_quq-zCUzmN6lzNCf6lJzoYKrFuDNI_F81K0IN9MY1-DTZQYBKLbyTkeXJk2oU9StnwEF63VJ1EHVMuPtIr8cG8aEe7G-GNmIXPZxbIBGU0OD_iwsvjEI6bCusMKpYsk7p-AduZCSClNUYS3myHzg-rYLbgj5c5ub5g0UrNKjoLK3fqcOyhLIetRRmI_Rt6fjZ6Ysy6AZXUs1gLscu0plP0mqSJqXWlLylrMOv2Sd4Pg33ngXGnh-CksQxR1ah6mWZ6Zl2R5oJkcZBXzCUTYumbeCl7RpEKbGEG3l61bClgJZ13KzBvzW1VmmvLWLi5d48uq7JcYwMSiOgbNjCyklgPdxzx1ppe1M9i293Pb0m8JolZZVYrkNbvdQWI%3D)
---
When I returned from my last deployment, I was absolutely aghast at what the Left was trying to do to our country and our values. Between out of control crime, lavish, outlandish spending, and socialist propaganda in our schools, I saw the very values I fought for slipping away.

**I didn’t watch my brothers and sisters in arms make the ultimate sacrifice defending our values just to let the Democrats destroy them in vain.**

**No one loves America like I do, Fellow Patriot, and just because I’ve retired my Navy Uniform doesn’t mean I’m done fighting for our future. Now, I’m on a new mission to take back the U.S. Senate and defend the American Dream for our families and generations to come.**

clean_body: | | | Fellow Patriot, By now, you’ve probably heard that I’m running for U.S. Senate. But I wanted to take just two minutes to tell you my story and explain why I’ve joined this fight. I was born in Communist Vietnam during the war. My father bravely spoke out against the Communist Party - and he was put on a kill list for it. We were fortunate to legally immigrate to the United States, where we found freedom and a new life. If it wasn’t for America’s freedom and generosity, I might not be alive right now. I came to this country not speaking a word of English. But in just fourteen years, I was appointed to the United States Naval Academy to prepare for a career defending America. I went on to become a Captain in the Navy and I served for 25 years in special operations diffusing explosives and performing deep sea dives. I saw some of the most dangerous corners of the world, from Afghanistan to Somalia. But all the sacrifices and hard work was worth it, because I knew I was giving back to the country that gave me everything. When I returned from my last deployment, I was absolutely aghast at what the Left was trying to do to our country and our values. Between out of control crime, lavish, outlandish spending, and socialist propaganda in our schools, I saw the very values I fought for slipping away. I didn’t watch my brothers and sisters in arms make the ultimate sacrifice defending our values just to let the Democrats destroy them in vain. No one loves America like I do, Fellow Patriot, and just because I’ve retired my Navy Uniform doesn’t mean I’m done fighting for our future. Peter,

name: Dr. Shawn Wilson for Governor
subject: Opening the doors in Baton Rouge
body:
image of ... [https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP50/1/104399/images/swlogo2.png]
TEAM WILSON WEEKLY UPDATES
Peter,
This week I was proud to host the grand opening for our Baton Rouge campaign office, the next step as we vault forward toward the qualifying period - which is now in just over a week away !
Team Wilson is proudly traversing the state - north to south, east to west, CENLA to North Louisiana - we’re hitting all 64 parishes!
CHIP IN [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/sw-web]
HIGHLIGHTS FROM THE CAMPAIGN TRAIL
St. Tammany
We had a spirited time at the St. Tammany Democratic Party meeting.
There was standing room only as residents and supporters gathered to hear my position on issues including the economy, education, women’s health, infrastructure, and, yes, library books.
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP50/1/104399/images/My%20project-1%20-%202023-07-28T084102.567.png]
Rapides Parish
I was grateful for the opportunity to share my plan to bolster our economy and support local businesses with the North Rapides Business & Industry Alliance at Louisiana Christian University on Monday.
By supporting small businesses, ensuring tax codes work for families, and raising wages for our hardworking Louisianans, we can revitalize our economy and strengthen our communities.
Thank you to State Senator W. Jay Luneau , State Reps. Ed Larvadain, III , and Rodney Lyons , and everyone else who came out to the event!
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP50/1/104399/images/My%20project-1%20-%202023-07-28T085404.802.png]
Baton Rouge
Thank you to everyone who came out to the grand opening of our Baton Rouge office Tuesday afternoon. It was truly a GRAND opening, with dozens of Louisianans coming out to support the gubernatorial candidate most committed to working with all stakeholders to accomplish wonderful things for our state.
I was grateful for the attendance of Baton Rouge Mayor-President Sharon Weston Broome and many other leaders who share my vision.
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP50/1/104399/images/My%20project-1%20-%202023-07-28T085957.338.png]
Marksville
I was proud to spend a morning with the Louisiana Association of Chiefs of Police at their annual conference in Marksville.
We had a healthy discussion on public safety and addressing crime, one of the most important issues to Louisianans.
For law enforcement to do their jobs effectively we must provide resources to advance technology and workforce development.
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP50/1/104399/images/My%20project-1%20-%202023-07-28T090314.458.png]
Westwego
I was proud to attend the USW Local Union 13-447 executive committee and general membership meeting Wednesday evening.
We talked about kitchen table issues like controlling insurance costs, fairness in education, workforce challenges, and public safety.
I am glad to stand with these hardworking men and women.
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP50/1/104399/images/Shawn%20Wilson%20%20copy-High-Quality%20-%202023-07-27T071823.585.jpg]
GIVING PRAISE
Orleans & Jefferson Parish
Thank you to Bishop Nelson Brown for a warm welcome to Fischer Community Church in Algiers, the community I grew up in. My Mom, Rocki, and I had a wonderful worship service. I appreciate your commitment to protect and build the community of Algiers.
The second service Sunday was at Second Zion Baptist Church in Marrero , a community where a large portion of my father's family is from- the Wilsons, Colemans, Rileys, and so many others.
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP50/1/104399/images/My%20project-1%20-%202023-07-28T084532.190.png]
ENDORSEMENTS
Bogalusa Mayor Tyrin Truong
"I want to be a part of the next Louisiana, a better Louisiana. Electing Dr. Shawn Wilson as Governor will help get us there," said Bogalusa Mayor Tyrin Truong . "Dr. Wilson knows that higher education is the gateway to innovation and economic prosperity and that attracting tomorrow's business leaders to our institutions requires investments in faculty and research that will meet the demands of the future market and workforce."
https://www.wilsonforla.com/sen-cleo-fields-endorses-shawn-wilson-for-governor [https://www.wilsonforla.com/sen-cleo-fields-endorses-shawn-wilson-for-governor]
Iberville Parish Councilmember Raheem Pierce
"With his experience securing federal funding, Dr. Shawn Wilson can effectively address Louisianans' concerns with issues like affordable housing. I'm grateful to know that when elected Governor, he will work to ensure the State Housing Trust Fund has regular funding," said Iberville Parish Councilmember Raheem Pierce . "Each and every corner of this state has benefited from Dr. Wilson's service to this state already. I cannot wait to see the greatness achieved in a Wilson administration."
https://www.wilsonforla.com/sen-cleo-fields-endorses-shawn-wilson-for-governor [https://www.wilsonforla.com/sen-cleo-fields-endorses-shawn-wilson-for-governor]
To learn more about my candidacy visit wilsonforla.com [wilsonforla.com] .
With hope,
Shawn Wilson

name: Lexie, Tammy Baldwin for Senate
subject: In a pinch
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY TAMMY BALDWIN FOR SENATE
body:
| The response to our latest goal has been... a little slow since we announced it.
# [](https://act.tammybaldwin.com/go/67?t=1&akid=737%2E35263%2EN_OMli)
Hi Peter — Lexie here, reporting to you live from Tammy Baldwin’s campaign office in Wisconsin! A few days ago, we set an ambitious goal: 10,000 grassroots donors by the end of July. But truthfully, the response to this goal has been... a little slower than we expected. You see, fundraising during the summer months isn’t easy. Folks are logging off, taking vacations, and spending time with their families and friends. _As they should!_ The problem is, when our grassroots fundraising struggles, it puts our campaign in a bit of a pinch. Tammy doesn’t have a rolodex of right-wing mega-millionaire donors to call up like National Republicans do. She also can’t cut herself multi-million dollar campaign checks the way some of her potential opponents can! Instead, our team relies on our incredible grassroots supporters (like you!) who give what they can, when they can, because they believe in Tammy and what she’s fighting for. **So here’s my ask of you today: Since you’re reading this email, I’m hoping you can help us catch up on our grassroots donor goal and pitch in any amount today to Tammy’s campaign. You can use this link here to chip in:[ secure.actblue.com/donate/tbe-em-jul23?refcode=dpwillis67@gmail.com](https://act.tammybaldwin.com/go/2155?c0=tbe-em-jul23.xghWlz&refcode=AU_STB_FR_GEN_EOM_AC_20230728_PM1_V1_S1&t=4&akid=737%2E35263%2EN_OMli)** Thanks so much for helping us get back on track! — Lexie _Finance Director

Peter,
Today we’ve got exciting news, and we had to tell you right away. Emerge is ramping up our programs to empower MORE Democratic women and meet this crucial moment in shaping the future of our democracy.
**Now, we’ve officially launched our second-ever cohort of Seated Together –[our program designed to empower trailblazing Black women to move up the political pipeline and deepen their impact for our communities!](https://click.everyaction.com/k/67210937/418996809/-1657939538?amounts=5,10,20,100,250&refcode=jtk1260-fr-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9BVi9BVkVNUi8xLzgxMzIxIiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjQ3ZDdhOTMxLTliMmQtZWUxMS1iOGYwLTAwMjI0ODMyZWI3MyIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=4_MMGaG-XAtYOKs0FtFeXur4V8zQ0_x5nGbdmSXGLyE=)**
**Just take a look at this incredible group of history makers: **
[](https://click.everyaction.com/k/67210938/418996811/-1657939538?amounts=5,10,20,100,250&refcode=jtk1260-fr-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9BVi9BVkVNUi8xLzgxMzIxIiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjQ3ZDdhOTMxLTliMmQtZWUxMS1iOGYwLTAwMjI0ODMyZWI3MyIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=4_MMGaG-XAtYOKs0FtFeXur4V8zQ0_x5nGbdmSXGLyE=)
This is a major milestone in our work to transform politics and achieve fair and inclusive representation at every single level of our government. Many Seated Together members have already achieved historic victories, becoming the FIRST Black women to hold their office! But we can’t stop there, Peter.
**Right now, there are no Black women in the U.S. Senate, there are no Black women governors, and only a handful of states and cities have ever elected Black women to Congress or the mayor’s office. That means vital voices are missing, and ALL our communities feel the impact of that gap. **
To achieve a truly inclusive democracy for the FIRST time in our history, we must elevate bold Black women – who are already leaders in their communities! – to higher office. Together, our alums can help deliver political representation that reflects more of our communities and brings solutions that meet more of our needs.
Our team is so grateful for Emerge community members like you who share our commitment to this work. We know it takes a movement to shatter glass ceilings in politics, and we’re glad you’re with us. **[If you can: Please chip in $5 or more today to help Emerge expand our unique training and empowerment programs like Seated Together.
